pool.heading: Registration of Condominium plans. Plans of redivision of amalgamation and appeals against refusals.
pool.text: issue of ''certificate of Condominium Title", in respect of such condominium parcels on receipt of the prescribed fee.

pool.heading: Registration of Condominium plans. Plans of redivision of amalgamation and appeals against refusals.
pool.text: Sections 34, 35 and 37 of the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998, shall, mutatis mutandis, apply to the inspection of the title register and the cadastral map, issue of certified copies of documents and extracts of cadastral maps and obtaining of certificate of ownership or interest of the condominium parcel or parcels.

pool.heading: Registration of Condominium plans. Plans of redivision of amalgamation and appeals against refusals.
pool.text: Where the Registrar refuses to register the Condominium Plan or the Provisional Condominium Plan or the Semi Condominium Plan or the Plan of amendment, or the plan of redivision or the Plan of amalgamation or the Plan of additions as the case may be, he shall make an order of refusal and record his reasons for such order in the prescribed register and shall endorse the words "Registration of condominium title refused" or "Registration of provisional condominium title refused" or "Registration of semi condominium title refused", as the case may be, on the instruments and on the application made by the person who presented the application for such registration and shall, without payment or unnecessary delay issue to the applicant a copy of the reasons so recorded.

pool.heading: Registration of Condominium plans. Plans of redivision of amalgamation and appeals against refusals.
pool.text: An appeal shall lie from every order made by the Registrar refusing to register the Condominium Plan or the Provisional Condominium Plan, or the Semi Condominium Plan, or the Plan of amendment, or the Plan of re-division or the Plan of amalgamation or the Plan of additions and the provisions in section 38 of the Registration of Documents Ordinance shall, mutatis mutandis apply in relation to such appeal.

pool.heading: Registration of horizontal sub-division of buildings.
pool.text: Subject to the provisions of this Act and of the Apartment Ownership Law, No. 11 of 1973, the owner of any land parcel registered under this Act upon which a building comprising more than one storey has been constructed, may, upon payment of the prescribed fee make application in the prescribed form to the Registrar-General of Title for the registration of horizontal sub-division of buildings (hereinafter referred to as "condominium parcels") in accordance with a cadastral map called a condominium plan which shall accompany such application.

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.heading: Registration of horizontal sub-division of buildings.
pool.text: The reference number of the land parcel on which the building is constructed and the number of the condominium parcel as depicted on the cadastral map shall together be a sufficient reference to a condominium parcel.

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.heading: Registration of horizontal sub-division of buildings.
pool.text: The Registrar of Title shall refer such applications together with the condominium plan and the cadastral map to the Superintendent of Surveys for certification.

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: Any owner or owners of any land parcel or land parcels whose title to which has been registered under this Act, may amalgamate or sub-divide his or their land parcel by registering a plan of redivision or amalgamation or sub-division relating to such land parcels in accordance with the provisions of this Act.

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: An application for amalgamation or sub-division shall be made to the Registrar of Title with copy to the relevant Superintendant of Surveys and shall contain a declaration in the prescribed form made by the applicant which shall contain-

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: the particulars of every encumbrance, lis pendens, seizure, order or decree affecting the land parcel or land parcels if any;

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: a reference to the Title Register and a reference to the cadastral map registered in respect of such land parcel or land parcels;

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: a survey plan prepared by a duly authorized Surveyor in accordance with any regulation governing the conduct of such surveys and the preparation of such cadastral map showing the amalgamation or sub division of such land parcel or land parcels bearing a reference to the cadastral map showing such area;

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: Where the Superintendent of Surveys is satisfied that' the plan conforms to the cadastral map and any regulation governing such surveys and cadastral map, he shall notify the person who tendered such plan accordingly, and shall certify such plan on behalf of the Surveyor-General and shall cause necessary amendments to be made showing such sub-division or amalgamation on the cadastral map and forward a copy of the section of the cadastral map reflecting such amendment to the Registrar of Title of the District in which such Sand is situate.

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: The original of the plan tendered, field notes and request of the owners shall be filed of record in the Office of the Superintendant of Surveys.

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: (a) On receipt of a certified section of a cadastral Map from the Superintendent of Surveys the Registrar of Title shall, if he is satisfied that such application for subdivision or amalgamation conforms to the provisions of this Act and the regulations made thereunder, register such land parcel or land parcels in the Title Register with accurate cross-references to the former Title records relating to such land.

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: The application and documents received shall be filed by the Registrar of Title in the relevant parcels file.

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: Upon the registration of a plan of amalgamation, or sub-division-

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: the land parcel or land parcels depicted therein shall be deemed to be amalgamated or sub-divided as defined therein;

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: such land parcel or land parcels shall be subject to the burden and shall have the benefit, of any servitudes affecting such land parcel or land parcels in the original cadastral map relating to such land parcel or land parcels as are included in the plan of amalgamation or sub-division.

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.heading: Registration of deed or instrument affecting a unit.
pool.text: No person acquiring an title or interest or benefit in any condominium parcel of a registered Condominium Property or of a registered Semi Condominium Property shall be entitled to such title or interest, or benefit, unless such title, or interest or benefit is registered under the provisions of Registration of Title Act. No. 21 of 1998.

pool.heading: Registration of deed or instrument affecting a unit.
pool.text: Upon accepting for registration, of any instrument for conveying title or interest or benefit in a condominium parcel, the Registrar shall register same in the title register in respect of relevant condominium parcel in the prescribed manner and make suitable cross references to registered Condominium Plan, or registered Semi Condominium Plan.

pool.heading: Registration of deed or instrument affecting a unit.
pool.text: The provisions of sections 40, 41, 42, 43, 44, 45, 46, 47, 48 and 49 of the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998, shall, mutatis mutandis, apply in respect of subsequent transaction relating to registered condominium parcel,".

pool.heading: Attestor to forward instruments attested within seven days.
pool.text: (a) Any instrument attested in terms of section 44 together with the Certificate of Title pertaining to the title of the vendor shall be forwarded by the Attestor working days of such attestation to the Registrar of Title within whose area of jurisdiction the land parcel dealt with in such instrument is situate.

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.heading: Attestor to forward instruments attested within seven days.
pool.text: Failure to forward the attested instrument within the stipulated period shall be an offence punishable with the prescribed penalty.

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.heading: Attestor to forward instruments attested within seven days.
pool.text: The Registrar of Title shall record the receipt of such instrument in the books maintained by him under the provisions of this Act and satisfy himself of the following:-

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.heading: Attestor to forward instruments attested within seven days.
pool.text: that the instrument has been drawn in accordance with the provisions of this Act;

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.heading: Attestor to forward instruments attested within seven days.
pool.text: that the land parcel has been identified and described accurately and conforms with the description of such land parcel in the Registers in the Title Registry;

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.heading: Attestor to forward instruments attested within seven days.
pool.text: that the person conveying such title or interest had the capacity to execute such instrument according to the information available in the Registers in the Title Registry;

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.heading: Attestor to forward instruments attested within seven days.
pool.text: that the title or interest conveyed or dealt with, has been unambiguously identified and conforms to that recorded in the Registers in the Title Registry.

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.heading: Attestor to forward instruments attested within seven days.
pool.text: If the Registrar of Title is of the opinion that all requirements for registration under this Act are complied with, he shall register such title or interest in the prescribed manner, file the instrument creating or transferring such title or interest and the Certificate of Title submitted by the vendor in the relevant parcels file and issue a Certificate of Title to the person who tendered the instrument;

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 45(3), proviso
pool.heading: Attestor to forward instruments attested within seven days.
pool.text: Provided that where such instrument pertains to a lease or a mortgage, the old Certificate of Title too shall be returned to such person with an endorsement made on it by the Registrar of Title making reference to such lease or mortgage. The Registrar of Title shall inform the Surveyor-General of all new entries immediately upon completion of the registration.

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: In this Act unless the context otherwise requires-

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "instrument"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means a document having the effect of conveying title to and interest in any land parcel in the prescribed form,

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "interest in land parcel"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means an interest Jess than full ownership of the land parcel and includes any Servitudes or encumbrance over such land parcel;

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "land"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: includes land covered with water, and any benefit arising out of any land, all things attached to the earth or permanently fastened thereto ;

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "licensed auctioneer"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means an auctioneer licensed under the Auctioneers and Brokers Ordinance (Chapter 109);

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "Minister"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means the Minister to whom the subject of lands has been assigned ;

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "owner"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means-

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "owner"(a)
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: in relation to a land parcel the person named in the Title Register as the owner thereof, and ;

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "owner"(b)
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: in relation to an interest in a land parcel, the person named in the register as the person in whose favour the interest is registered;

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "Land parcel"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means an area of land separately delineated on the cadastral map ;

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "Registrar-General of Title"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: includes any Deputy or Assistant;

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "Registrar of Title"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means any person appointed as Registrar of Title under this Act;

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "registered land"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means a land parcel the title to which is registered under this Act;

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "servitude"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means a right enjoyed by a person over a land parcel owned by another person ;

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "Surveyor-General"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means the officer appointed as Surveyor-General of Sri Lanka or any other officer appointed in writing to act on his behalf for the purposes of this Act to the extent specified in such letter of appointment;

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "Superintendent of Surveys"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means any person performing the functions of a Superintendent of Surveys in the Survey Department;

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "Title Register"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means the Title Register under the provisions of this Act.

hierarchy.label: Registration of Title Act No. 21 of 1998

pool.heading: Duties, & c, of management corporations.
pool.text: The duties of the management corporation shall include the following:

pool.heading: Duties, & c, of management corporations.
pool.text: to manage and properly maintain the common elements and keep them in a state of good and serviceable repair;

pool.heading: Duties, & c, of management corporations.
pool.text: unless otherwise directed by unanimous resolution, to insure and keep insured the subdivided building to the replacement value thereof against fire and such other risks as may be prescribed under this Law;

pool.heading: Duties, & c, of management corporations.
pool.text: to effect such other insurance of the subdivided building as may be required by law;

pool.heading: Duties, & c, of management corporations.
pool.text: to insure against such other risks as the owners of all the condominium parcels may by special resolution direct.;

pool.heading: Duties, & c, of management corporations.
pool.text: to forthwith apply insurance moneys received by it in respect of damage to the subdivided building in rebuilding and reinstating it so far as it may be lawful to do so;

pool.heading: Duties, & c, of management corporations.
pool.text: to pay premiums on any policy of insurance effected by it;

pool.heading: Duties, & c, of management corporations.
pool.text: to comply with any notice or order made by any Government, public or statuary authority requiring the abatement of any nuisance on the common elements or ordering repairs or other work to be done in respect of the common elements or any building or other improvement on the Condominium Property or Semi Condominium Property";;

pool.heading: Duties, & c, of management corporations.
pool.text: to comply with any notice or order made by any government, public authority requiring the removal of any unauthorized constructions effected to any Condominium Property or Semi Condominium Property in contravention of the approved building plan, and to request and to assist the Condominium Management Authority or the Urban Development Authority or the local authority for such removal;

pool.heading: Duties, & c, of management corporations.
pool.text: to comply with any such notice or order as is referred to in paragraph (g) given or made in respect of any of the condominium parcels, if the owner of a condominium parcel fails to do so within a reasonable time:

pool.heading: Duties, & c, of management corporations.
pool.text: and (1) to pay the rent (if any) on the land on which the subdivided building is erected-

pool.heading: Duties, & c, of management corporations.
pool.text: The powers of the management corporation shall include the following:

pool.heading: Duties, & c, of management corporations.
pool.text: to take lawful steps to recover from any owner of a condominium parcel any sum expended by the management corporation in respect of that owner's condominium parcel in complying with any such notice or order as is referred to in paragraph (h) of subsection (1);

pool.heading: Duties, & c, of management corporations.
pool.text: to contract with the National Water Supply and Drainage Board, the Ceylon Electricity Board, any local authority, any other authority or any other licensee for the supply water, electricity and other utilities for all condominium parcels of the building and to provide such services to all owners of the Condominium parcels, on recovery of service charges, and monthly charges for such consumptions;

pool.heading: Duties, & c, of management corporations.
pool.text: to take every step to recover the monthly charges, for the consumption of water, electricity and other utilities provided by the National water Supply and Drainage Board, the Ceylon Electricity Board, any local authority any other authority or licensee by way of discontinuance of individual connections for water or electricity or other utilities and to continue the discontinuance of such supply to such condominium parcel, until the respective charges are being paid to the management corporation by the respective owner or owners of the condominium parcel or parcels;

pool.heading: Duties, & c, of management corporations.
pool.text: to purchase, hire or otherwise acquire movable property for use by the owners of all the condominium parcels in connection with their enjoyment of the common elements;

pool.heading: Duties, & c, of management corporations.
pool.text: to levy a monthly contribution on the owners of all the condominium parcels in proportion to the share parcels of their respective condominium parcels for the purposes mentioned in section 20H and to recover such contribution from the owners of all the condominium parcels.

pool.heading: Duties, & c, of management corporations.
pool.text: to borrow moneys required by it in the exercise of its powers or the performance of its duties;

pool.heading: Duties, & c, of management corporations.
pool.text: to secure the repayment of moneys borrowed by it and the payment of interest thereon by negotiable instrument or by a charge of unpaid contributions to the management fund, whether already levied or not; and

pool.heading: Duties, & c, of management corporations.
pool.text: to take lawful steps necessary for the performance of its duties under this Law and for the enforcement of the by-laws set out in the Second Schedule to this Law.

pool.heading: Duties, & c, of management corporations.
pool.text: to take every steps to prevent and to remove all unauthorized constructions effected to the Condominium Property or Semi Condominium Property in contrary to the approved building plan and to request or assist the Condominium Management Authority or the Urban Development Authority or any local authority to remove such unauthorized constructions.

pool.heading: Duties, & c, of management corporations.
pool.text: Immediately after the establishment of the management corporation by virtue of the operation of this Law the Condominium Management Authority shall subject to the provisions in the First Schedule to this Law, summon, not later than three months from the date of such establishment, the first annual general meeting of the management corporation and elect the first council, and such council shall cease to hold office at the next annual general meeting. Upon the elections of the first council, subject to the provisions in the First Schedule, the council shall perform the duties and exercise the powers of the management corporation and conduct the business of the management corporation on its behalf.

pool.heading: Duties, & c, of management corporations.
pool.text: A policy of insurance taken out by the management corporation under this section in respect of the subdivided building shall not be liable to be brought into contribution with any other policy of insurance, except another policy taken out under this section in respect of the same subdivided building.

pool.heading: Duties, & c, of management corporations.

pool.heading: Duties, & c, of management corporations.
pool.text: An owner of a condominium parcel who is not the owner of the condominium parcel at the time when the repairs, work or act referred to in subsection (5) were or was performed shall not be liable to pay to the management corporation any amount due under that subsection if he has, at any time on or within twenty-one days before the date he acquired the title or interest in the condominium parcel, made a requisition in writing to the management corporation to inquire about the amount (if any) recoverable by the management corporation under that subsection in respect of the condominium parcel and the management corporation has (a) certified that no amount is then recoverable by the management corporation in respect of the condominium parcel pursuant to subsection (5); or

pool.heading: Duties, & c, of management corporations.
pool.text: not given a reply to the requisition at any time within fourteen days of the date of the service of the requisition, and where the management corporation has certified that any amount is due under subsection (5), the liability of such owner shall be limited to the amount so certified.

pool.heading: Duties, & c, of management corporations.
pool.text: Where the management corporation incurs any expenditure or performs any repairs, work or act (whether or not the expenditure was incurred or the repairs, work or act were or was performed consequent upon the service on it by any Government or statutory authority of any notice or order) and the expenditure or the repairs, work or act were or was rendered necessary by reason of any willful or negligent act or omission on the part of, or breach of any provision of its by-laws by any person or his tenant, lessee, licensee or invitee, the amount of that expenditure of any money expended by it in performing the repairs, work or act shall be recoverable by it from that person as a debt in an action in any court of competent jurisdiction.

pool.heading: Duties, & c, of management corporations.
pool.text: The generality of this section shall not be prejudiced by any other provisions of this Law conferring a power or imposing a duty on the management corporation.

pool.heading: As to the validity of foreign wills
pool.text: Every will made beyond the limits of Sri Lanka containing any devise or disposition of immovable property situate within Sri Lanka, which shall have been duly made and executed according to and in conformity with the forms and solemnities prescribed by the law of the country where the same shall have been so made and executed, by any person who by the law of such country or of Sri Lanka if competent to make a will, shall be valid and effectual to alienate and pass the property in any immovable property so devised or disposed of by any such testator; and every will be duly made and executed in manner aforesaid, in any place beyond the limits of Sri Lanka, by any person who shall be competent to make a will by the law of the place where he shall be domiciled at the time of making and executing the same, shall be valid and effectual to alienate and pass the property in any movable property by such will bequeathed or disposed of, anything contained in the Prevention of Frauds Ordinance or any other law or custom to the contrary notwithstanding.

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: a charge on goodwill or intellectual property within the meaning of the Intellectual Property Act, No. 36 of 2003; and

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: a trust receipt to which section 4 of the Trust Receipts Ordinance (Cap. 86) applies or an inland trust receipt within the meaning of the Inland Trust Receipts Act, No. 14 of 1990.

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: An instrument which is required to be registered under this section shall-

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: in the case of instruments executed in Sri Lanka, be registered within twenty - one working days of the date of execution of the instrument; or

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: in the case of an instrument executed outside Sri Lanka, be registered within three months of the date of execution of the instrument.

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: Where a charge is created in Sri Lanka but comprises of property outside Sri Lanka, the instrument creating or purporting to create the charge may be sent for registration under the provisions of this section, notwithstanding that further proceedings may be necessary to make the charge valid or effectual according to the law of the country in which the property is situated.

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: Where a negotiable instrument has been given to secure the payment of any book debts of a company, the deposit of the instrument for the purpose of securing an advance to the company, shall not for the purposes of this section, be treated as a charge on those book debts.

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: The holding of debentures entitling the holder to a charge on land shall not for the purposes of this section, be treated as an interest in land.

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: Where a series of debentures containing or giving by reference to any other instrument any charge to the benefit of which the debenture holder of that series are entitled pari passu is created by a company, it shall for the purposes of this section be sufficient if, within fifteen working days from the date of execution of the deed containing the charge or if there is no such deed, from the date of execution of any debentures of the series, the following particulars:-

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: the total amount secured by the whole series;

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: the dates of the resolutions authorising the issue of the series and the date of the covering deed, if any, by which the security is created or defined;

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: a general description of the property charged; and

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: the names of the trustees, if any, for the debenture holders,

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: together with a copy of the deed containing the charge verified in the prescribed manner, or if there is no such deed, one of the debentures of the series, are delivered to or received by the Registrar:

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: Provided that, where more than one issue is made of debentures in the series, there shall be sent to the Registrar for entry in the register particulars of the date and amount of each issue. An omission to send such particulars shall not affect the validity of the debentures issued.

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: Where any commission, allowance or discount has been paid or made either directly or indirectly by a company to any person, in consideration of his-

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: subscribing or agreeing to subscribe whether absolutely or conditionally, for any debentures of the company; or

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: procuring or agreeing to procure subscriptions whether absolute or conditional, for any such debentures,

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: the particulars required to be sent for registration under the provisions of this section shall include particulars as to the amount or rate per centum of the commission, discount or allowance so paid or made. An omission to send such particulars shall not affect the validity of the debentures issued.

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: The deposit of any debentures as security for any debt of the company shall not for the purposes of subsection (8), be treated as the issue of the debentures at a discount.

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: Registration of a charge under this section may be effected on the application of any person interested in it. Where registration is effected on the application of a person other than the company, that person shall be entitled to recover from the company the amount of any fees paid by him to the Registrar.

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: Where any company fails to send to the Registrar for registration the particulars of any charge created by the company or of the issue of debentures of a series which requires registration under this section, then, unless the registration has been affected on the application of some other person-

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: the company shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding fifty thousand rupees; and

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: every officer of the company who is in default shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding fifty thousand rupees.

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: The provisions of this section shall be in addition to and not in substitution of any other written law relating to the registration of any document or instrument creating or purporting to create a charge on any property, whether movable or immovable.

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: For the purpose of this Part of this Act, "charge" includes a mortgage.

pool.citation: Matrimonial Rights and Inheritance Ordinance, s 21(1)
pool.heading: Inheritance to immovable property in Sri Lanka to be governed by this Ordinance.
pool.text: Inheritance ab interstate to the immovable property in Sri Lanka of a person deceased shall be governed and regulated by the following provisions of this Ordinance wherever such person may have or have had his actual or matrimonial domicile. Inheritance to movable property to be governed by the law of domicile.

hierarchy.label: Matrimonial Rights and Inheritance Ordinance No. 15 of 1876

pool.citation: Matrimonial Rights and Inheritance Ordinance, s 21(2)
pool.heading: Inheritance to immovable property in Sri Lanka to be governed by this Ordinance.
pool.text: Inheritance ab interstate to the movable property of a person deceased shall be governed and regulated by the law of the country in which he had his domicile at the time of his death:

hierarchy.label: Matrimonial Rights and Inheritance Ordinance No. 15 of 1876

pool.citation: Matrimonial Rights and Inheritance Ordinance, s 21(2), proviso
pool.heading: Inheritance to immovable property in Sri Lanka to be governed by this Ordinance.
pool.text: Provided that when any person shall have his domicile in any part of Sri Lanka, such domicile shall, so far as relates to the inheritance to his movable property, be deemed to be in the Maritime provinces;

hierarchy.label: Matrimonial Rights and Inheritance Ordinance No. 15 of 1876

pool.citation: Matrimonial Rights and Inheritance Ordinance, s 21(2), proviso
pool.heading: Inheritance to immovable property in Sri Lanka to be governed by this Ordinance.
pool.text: Provided also that if a person dies leaving movable property in Sri Lanka, in the absence of proof of his domicile elsewhere, the inheritance to such property shall be governed by the following provisions of this Ordinance.

hierarchy.label: Matrimonial Rights and Inheritance Ordinance No. 15 of 1876

pool.heading: Duty of company to register charges existing on property acquired.
pool.text: Where a company registered in Sri Lanka acquires any property which is subject to a charge that would, if it had been created by the company after the acquisition of the property, have been required to be registered under this Part, the company shall, within the time specified by subsection (2), deliver to the Registrar for registration-

pool.heading: Duty of company to register charges existing on property acquired.
pool.text: the prescribed particulars of the charge; and

pool.heading: Duty of company to register charges existing on property acquired.
pool.text: a copy (certified in the prescribed manner to be a correct copy) of the instrument, if any, by which the charge was created or is evidenced.

pool.heading: Duty of company to register charges existing on property acquired.
pool.text: Particulars of a charge which is required to be registered under subsection (1) shall be delivered to the Registrar-

pool.heading: Duty of company to register charges existing on property acquired.
pool.text: if the property is situated and the charge was created outside Sri Lanka, within three months of the date on which the acquisition is completed; or

pool.heading: Duty of company to register charges existing on property acquired.
pool.text: in all other cases within twenty-one working days of the date on which the acquisition is completed.

pool.heading: Duty of company to register charges existing on property acquired.
pool.text: Where a company fails to comply with this section-

pool.heading: Duty of company to register charges existing on property acquired.
pool.text: the company shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding fifty thousand rupees; and

pool.heading: Duty of company to register charges existing on property acquired.
pool.text: every officer of the company who is in default shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding fifty thousand rupees.

pool.heading: Company incorporated for business outside Sri Lanka.
pool.text: Any company may make an application to the Registrar in accordance with the provisions of this Part of this Act to be registered in Sri Lanka as an off-shore company and to be so referred to, and in the case of a company incorporated abroad, to be deemed to be incorporated in Sri Lanka, as if it had been incorporated under the provisions of this Act.

hierarchy.label: Part XI — PROVISIONS RELATING TO OFFSHORE COMPANIES

pool.heading: Company incorporated for business outside Sri Lanka.
pool.text: An application for registration under subsection (1) shall have annexed thereto the following documents:-

hierarchy.label: Part XI — PROVISIONS RELATING TO OFFSHORE COMPANIES

pool.heading: Company incorporated for business outside Sri Lanka.
pool.text: a certified copy of the charter, statute or memorandum and articles of association of the company or other instrument constituting or defining the constitution of the company, and where such instrument is not in an official language or in English, a translation of the instrument in such language as may be specified by the Registrar;

hierarchy.label: Part XI — PROVISIONS RELATING TO OFFSHORE COMPANIES

pool.heading: Company incorporated for business outside Sri Lanka.
pool.text: a list of the directors or those managing the affairs of the company, containing their full names, addresses, occupations and the offices they hold in the company;

hierarchy.label: Part XI — PROVISIONS RELATING TO OFFSHORE COMPANIES

pool.heading: Company incorporated for business outside Sri Lanka.
pool.text: the names and addresses of one or more persons who are resident in and are citizens of Sri Lanka, who is or are authorised to represent the company;

hierarchy.label: Part XI — PROVISIONS RELATING TO OFFSHORE COMPANIES

pool.heading: Company incorporated for business outside Sri Lanka.
pool.text: a statement containing the full address of-

hierarchy.label: Part XI — PROVISIONS RELATING TO OFFSHORE COMPANIES

pool.heading: Company incorporated for business outside Sri Lanka.
pool.text: the registered or principal office of the company in the country of incorporation; and

hierarchy.label: Part XI — PROVISIONS RELATING TO OFFSHORE COMPANIES

pool.heading: Company incorporated for business outside Sri Lanka.
pool.text: the office of the company in Sri Lanka;

hierarchy.label: Part XI — PROVISIONS RELATING TO OFFSHORE COMPANIES

pool.heading: Company incorporated for business outside Sri Lanka.
pool.text: a certified copy (certified of recent date of the incorporation of the company).

hierarchy.label: Part XI — PROVISIONS RELATING TO OFFSHORE COMPANIES

pool.heading: Company incorporated for business outside Sri Lanka.
pool.text: The company shall notify the Registrar of any amendments or alterations in respect of any of the aforesaid particulars within the prescribed time, and in the prescribed form.

hierarchy.label: Part XI — PROVISIONS RELATING TO OFFSHORE COMPANIES

pool.heading: Disposition of property by a will.
pool.text: It shall be lawful for any person who has reached the age of eighteen years and residing within or outside Sri Lanka to execute a will bequeathing and disposing any movable and immovable property and all and every estate, right, share or interest in any property which belong to him at the time of death and which, if not so devised, bequeathed or disposed would devolve upon his heirs of such person not legally incapacitated from taking the same as he shall seem fit.

pool.heading: Disposition of property by a will.
pool.text: Every testator shall have full power to make such testamentary disposition as he shall feel disposed, and in the exercise of such right to exclude any child, parent, relative, or descendant, or to disinherit or omit to mention any such person, without assigning any reason for such exclusion, disinheritance, or omission, any law, usage, or custom now or herefore in force in Sri Lanka to the contrary notwithstanding.

pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: In this Act unless the context otherwise requires-

pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means transfer, lease or mortgage of lands situated within Sri Lanka;

pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means the Apartment Ownership Law, No. 11 of 1973;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Banking Act"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means the Banking Act, No. 30 of 1988;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Citizenship Act"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means Citizenship Act (Chapter 349);

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "citizen of Sri Lanka"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means a citizen of Sri Lanka in terms of Citizenship Act;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Companies Act"
pool.heading: Interpretation

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Commissioner General of Inland Revenue"
pool.provision_label: 25, definition of "Commissioner General of Inland Revenue"

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014
Definition of "Commissioner General of Inland Revenue"

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Diplomatic Privileges Act"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means the Diplomatic Privileges Act, No. 9 of 1996;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "foreigner"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means a person who is not a citizen of Sri Lanka;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "foreign company"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means a company or a body of persons incorporated under the laws of any country other than Sri Lanka;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Finance Leasing Act"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means the Finance Leasing Act, No. 56 of 2000;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Finance Leasing Institution"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means a Finance Leasing Establishment registered under the Finance Leasing Act;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "holding company"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: has the same meaning assigned to such expression under the Companies Act;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Inland Revenue Act"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means the Inland Revenue Act, No. 10 of 2006;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "land"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means any State or private land and includes-

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "land"(a)
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: any interest in the land;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "land"(b)
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: any land covered with water; and

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "land"(c)
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: any house or building stands on that land;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Minister"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means the Minister to whom the subject of Finance has been assigned;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "transfer"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means any sale, donation, gift or any conveyance by or under which the title of such land passes to another person;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "person"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: includes a body of persons incorporate or unincorporated;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Registration of Documents Ordinance"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means the Registration of Documents Ordinance (Chapter 117);

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "subsidiary"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: has the same meaning assigned to such expression under the Companies Act.

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Provisions as to expert's consent and allotment.
pool.text: It shall not be lawful for any person to issue, circulate or distribute in Sri Lanka, any prospectus offering for subscription shares in or debentures of a company incorporated outside Sri Lanka, whether the company has or has not established or when formed, will or will not be established, a place of business in Sri Lanka-

hierarchy.label: RESTRICTIONS ON SALE OF SHARES AND OFFER OF SHARE FOR SALE

pool.heading: Provisions as to expert's consent and allotment.
pool.text: if, where the prospectus includes a statement purporting to be made by an expert, he has not given or has before delivery of the prospectus for registration withdrawn his written consent to the issue of the prospectus, with the statement included in the form and context in which it is included, or there does not appear in the prospectus a statement that he has given and has not withdrawn his consent as aforesaid; or

hierarchy.label: RESTRICTIONS ON SALE OF SHARES AND OFFER OF SHARE FOR SALE

pool.heading: Provisions as to expert's consent and allotment.
pool.text: if the prospectus does not have the effect, where an application is made in pursuance thereof, of rendering all persons concerned bound by all the provisions other than penal provisions of section 47, so far as applicable thereto.

hierarchy.label: RESTRICTIONS ON SALE OF SHARES AND OFFER OF SHARE FOR SALE

pool.heading: Provisions as to expert's consent and allotment.
pool.text: In this section the expression "expert" includes an engineer, a Valuer, an accountant and any other person whose profession gives authority to a statement made by him, and for the purposes of this section, a statement shall be deemed to be included in a prospectus, if it is contained in or in any report or memorandum appearing on the face of or by reference incorporated in or issued with, such prospectus.

hierarchy.label: RESTRICTIONS ON SALE OF SHARES AND OFFER OF SHARE FOR SALE

pool.heading: Mortgage or alienation of immovable property invalid
pool.text: No mortgage, sale, or other alienation of immovable property belonging to any temple, shall be valid or of any effect in law:

pool.heading: Mortgage or alienation of immovable property invalid
pool.text: Provided that this section shall not apply either to a paraveni pangu or to a sale in execution of any property if the writ for the seizure thereof was issued after written notice of three months to the Commissioner of Buddhist Affairs.

pool.citation: Matrimonial Rights and Inheritance Ordinance, s 6
pool.heading: Rights of husband and wife in respect of immovable property situate in Sri Lanka to be governed by this Ordinance.
pool.text: * The respective matrimonial rights of every husband and wife, married after the proclamation of this Ordinance, in, to, or in respect of any immovable property situate in Sri Lanka shall, during such marriage, be governed by the provisions of this Ordinance.

hierarchy.label: Matrimonial Rights and Inheritance Ordinance No. 15 of 1876
Part II — MATRIMONIAL RIGHTS OF HUSBAND AND WIFE IN RESPECT OF PROPERTY

pool.heading: Restriction on transfer of land
pool.text: Notwithstanding any provision to the contrary in any other written law, the transfer of title of any land situated in Sri Lanka, shall be prohibited if such transfer is-

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Restriction on transfer of land
pool.text: to a foreigner; or

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Restriction on transfer of land
pool.text: to a company incorporated in Sri Lanka under the Companies Act where any foreign shareholding in such company, either direct or indirect, is fifty per cent or above; or

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Restriction on transfer of land
pool.text: to a foreign company, unless exempted as provided in section 3.

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Restriction on transfer of land
pool.text: For the purpose of maintaining the legal validity of a transfer of land to a company incorporated in Sri Lanka under the Companies Act, with less than fifty per cent of foreign shareholding, the foreign shareholding of such company shall remain less than fifty per cent, for a minimum period of consecutive twenty (20) years from the date of such transfer.

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Restriction on transfer of land
pool.text: Where the foreign shareholding of a company referred to in paragraph (a) reaches or exceeds fifty per cent, contrary to the provisions of paragraph (a), in consequent to-

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Restriction on transfer of land
pool.text: the change of ownership of shares directly or indirectly; or

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Restriction on transfer of land
pool.text: the death of a shareholder of such company and the shares of the deceased shareholder devolving, in accordance with the applicable laws of succession of Sri Lanka, on his next of kin who is a foreigner, the transfer of land referred to therein shall be void and shall have no effect in law, with effect from the date of increase of the foreign shareholding:

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 2(2)(b)(ii), proviso
pool.heading: Restriction on transfer of land
pool.text: Provided however, where a company referred to in paragraph (a),-

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Restriction on transfer of land
pool.text: listed in the Colombo Stock Exchange (with a minimum number of two hundred shareholders in the case of a Diri Savi Board and one thousand shareholders in the case of a Main Board), takes steps to reduce its foreign shareholding to less than fifty per cent, within a period of twelve months from the date of increase of its foreign shareholding; or

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Restriction on transfer of land
pool.text: other than a company referred to in sub-paragraph (i), takes steps to reduce its foreign shareholding to less than fifty per cent, within a period of six months from the date of increase of its foreign shareholding, in compliance with the provisions of that paragraph, the transfer of land referred to in paragraph (a), shall be deemed to be legally valid, with effect from the date of restoring the foreign shareholding of such company to less than fifty per cent.

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Restriction on transfer of land
pool.text: For the purposes of this section the expressions 'Diri Savi Board' and 'Main Board' shall be read and construed in accordance with the provisions of the Listing Rules of the Colombo Stock Exchange issued under its listing requirements, in terms of the Securities and Exchange Commission of Sri Lanka Rules, 2001, made under section 53 of the Securities and Exchange Commission of Sri Lanka Act, No. 36 of 1987 and published in Gazette Extraordinary No. 1215/2 of December 18, 2001.

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Dating of prospectus and particulars to be contained therein.
pool.text: It shall not be lawful for any person to issue, circulate, or distribute in Sri Lanka any prospectus offering for subscription any shares in or debentures of a company, incorporated or to be incorporated outside Sri Lanka, whether the company has or has not established or when formed will or will not establish a place of business in Sri Lanka, unless the prospectus is dated and-

hierarchy.label: RESTRICTIONS ON SALE OF SHARES AND OFFER OF SHARE FOR SALE

pool.heading: Dating of prospectus and particulars to be contained therein.
pool.text: contains particulars with respect to the following matters:-

hierarchy.label: RESTRICTIONS ON SALE OF SHARES AND OFFER OF SHARE FOR SALE

pool.heading: Dating of prospectus and particulars to be contained therein.
pool.text: the instrument constituting or defining the constitution of the company;

hierarchy.label: RESTRICTIONS ON SALE OF SHARES AND OFFER OF SHARE FOR SALE

pool.heading: Dating of prospectus and particulars to be contained therein.
pool.text: the enactments or provisions having the force of an enactment, by or under which the incorporation of the company was effected;

hierarchy.label: RESTRICTIONS ON SALE OF SHARES AND OFFER OF SHARE FOR SALE

pool.heading: Dating of prospectus and particulars to be contained therein.
pool.text: an address in Sri Lanka where the said instrument, enactments, or provisions or copies thereof and if the same are in a language other than the official language of Sri Lanka or in English, a translation thereof in a language specified by the Registrar and certified in the prescribed manner, can be inspected;

hierarchy.label: RESTRICTIONS ON SALE OF SHARES AND OFFER OF SHARE FOR SALE

pool.heading: Dating of prospectus and particulars to be contained therein.
pool.text: the date on which and the country in which the company was incorporated;

hierarchy.label: RESTRICTIONS ON SALE OF SHARES AND OFFER OF SHARE FOR SALE

pool.heading: Dating of prospectus and particulars to be contained therein.
pool.text: whether the company has established a place of business in Sri Lanka and, if so, the address of its principal office in Sri Lanka;

hierarchy.label: RESTRICTIONS ON SALE OF SHARES AND OFFER OF SHARE FOR SALE

pool.heading: Dating of prospectus and particulars to be contained therein.
pool.text: states the matters specified in Part I of the Fourth Schedule hereto, and subject to the provisions contained in Part III, sets out the reports specified in Part II, of that Schedule:

hierarchy.label: RESTRICTIONS ON SALE OF SHARES AND OFFER OF SHARE FOR SALE

pool.heading: Dating of prospectus and particulars to be contained therein.
pool.text: Provided that the provisions of subparagraphs (i), (ii) and (iii) of paragraph (a) shall not apply in the case of a prospectus issued more than two years from the date on which the company is entitled to commence business, and in the application of Part I of the Fourth Schedule hereto for the purposes of this subsection, paragraph 3 of Part I of such Schedule shall have effect with the substitution for the reference to the articles, of a reference to the constitution, of the company.

hierarchy.label: RESTRICTIONS ON SALE OF SHARES AND OFFER OF SHARE FOR SALE

pool.heading: Dating of prospectus and particulars to be contained therein.
pool.text: Any condition requiring or binding an applicant for shares or debentures, to waive compliance with any requirements imposed by virtue of paragraph (a) or paragraph (b) of subsection (1), or purporting to affect him with notice of any contract, document, or matter not specifically referred to in the prospectus, shall be void.

pool.text: the trustees not being bhikkhus of all temples situated within the divisional Assistant Government Agent's division in which the dewale is situated, to each of whom he shall send by registered post not less than one month before the date fixed for the said meeting a written notice thereof addressed to the last known place of abode of such person.

pool.heading: Trustee for dewales" Basnayake Nilame or other person
pool.text: The Commissioner of Buddhist Affairs shall preside at such meeting and every person duly summoned and present at such meeting shall have a vote at every ballot to fill the said vacancy. Such ballot shall always be secret.

pool.heading: Trustee for dewales" Basnayake Nilame or other person
pool.text: If at such meeting the name of not more than one person is proposed and seconded for election to the vacant office the Commissioner of Buddhist Affairs shall declare such person appointed Basnayake Nilame.

pool.heading: Trustee for dewales" Basnayake Nilame or other person
pool.text: If at such meeting the name of more than one person is proposed and seconded for election to the vacant office a ballot shall be held and the Commissioner of Buddhist Affairs shall declare the person (if any) who receives the highest number of votes at the ballot appointed Basnayake Nilame. But if at such ballot no candidate receives a greater number of votes than the number of votes received by each of the other candidates a second ballot shall be held confined to the candidates who have received the largest number of votes being equal and the Commissioner of Buddhist Affairs shall declare the person (if any) who receives the highest number of votes at such second ballot appointed Basnayake Nilame. If even at such second ballot no candidate receives a greater number of votes than the number of votes received by each of the other candidates the Commissioner of Buddhist Affairs shall by lot determine which of the candidates receiving the highest number of votes at such second ballot shall be deemed to have headed the poll and shall thereafter declare him appointed the Basnayake Nilame.

pool.heading: Trustee for dewales" Basnayake Nilame or other person

pool.heading: No survivorship as to property undivided held in shares, unless expressly stipulated for.
pool.text: And for the avoiding of all doubts and questions as to the respective rights of persons jointly holding landed property situated within certain districts of Sri Lanka, it is further enacted and declared that all landed property situated in Sri Lanka which shall belong to two or more persons jointly, whether the same shall have come to them by grant, purchase, descent, or otherwise, is and shall be deemed and taken to be held by them in common, and upon the decease of any of such persons the said property so jointly possessed shall not remain or belong to the survivor, but all the right, share, and interest of the person so dying in and to the property so jointly possessed as aforesaid shall form part of his estate; and the person or persons to whom the same shall by him be devised or bequeathed, or to whom it shall devolve, shall thereupon become and be co- proprietors with the survivor in the said property, in the proportion and according to the share of such deceased person therein, unless the instrument under which the said property is jointly held and possessed, or any agreement mutually entered into between them, shall expressly provide that the survivor, upon such decease, shall become entitled to the whole estate.

query_text: A plaintiff institutes an action to enforce a Thesawalamai right of pre-emption but has not yet proved registration of the action as a lis pendens. The court is also considering requiring security for the plaintiff's bona fides. What must occur before notice or summons is issued, what monetary deposit may the court order, and what is the consequence of failing to make that deposit within the permitted period?
match_expression: "plaintiff" OR "institutes" OR "action" OR "enforce" OR "thesawalamai" OR "right" OR "pre" OR "emption" OR "yet" OR "proved" OR "registration" OR "lis" OR "pendens" OR "court" OR "also" OR "considering" OR "requiring" OR "security" OR "s" OR "bona" OR "fides" OR "must" OR "occur" OR "before" OR "notice" OR "summons" OR "issued" OR "monetary" OR "deposit" OR "may" OR "order" OR "consequence" OR "failing" OR "make" OR "within" OR "permitted" OR "period"

pool.heading: Deposit of purchase money as proof of plaintiff's bona fides.
pool.text: At any time after the institution of an action to enforce a right of pre-emption, the court may in its discretion order the plaintiff to deposit the purchase amount set out in the notice given under section 5; and if the plaintiff makes default in depositing the amount within such period, or further periods not exceeding three months in the aggregate, as the court may allow, his action shall be struck off the roll of pending cases.

pool.heading: Registration of lis pendens to be compulsory.
pool.text: No precept or order for the service of notice or summons shall be issued in any proceedings or action for enforcing a right of pre-emption, until proof is furnished to the court of the registration of the proceedings or action as a lis pendens in accordance with the provisions of the Registration of Documents Ordinance.

pool.heading: The minimum price payable by the plaintiff.
pool.text: No person seeking to enforce a right of pre-emption by way of petition or by regular action, shall be permitted to take over the property for a less amount than that stated in the notice given under section 5 or recited as the consideration in the deed of transfer executed by the vendor:

pool.heading: The minimum price payable by the plaintiff.
pool.text: Provided, however, that if the amount so stated or recited is proved to the satisfaction of the court to be fictitious, the court may ascertain the actual price paid and the market value, and allow the property to be pre-empted by the plaintiff for the price actually paid or at the market value, whichever of these is the larger.

pool.heading: Time-limit to action for enforcing right.
pool.text: No action to enforce a right of pre-emption on the ground that the notice required by section 5 was not given or that the notice given was irregular or defective shall be instituted or maintained -

pool.heading: Time-limit to action for enforcing right.
pool.text: if the actual purchaser of the land is also a person who at the time of the purchase had the right of pre-emption over the property purchased by him; or

pool.heading: Time-limit to action for enforcing right.
pool.text: if more than one year has elapsed from the date of the registration of the purchaser's deed of transfer.

pool.heading: Remedy after the completion of the proposed sale.
pool.text: After the completion of a sale of which notice has been given under section 5 or of any sale of which notice has not been given under that section, the right of pre-emption shall not be enforced except by way of regular action, to which the purchaser shall also be made a party.

pool.heading: Remedy after the completion of the proposed sale.
pool.text: An action to enforce the right of pre-emption under subsection (1) may be instituted on any of the following grounds: -

pool.heading: Remedy after the completion of the proposed sale.
pool.text: that the notice required by section 5 was not given or that the notice given was irregular or defective;

pool.heading: Remedy after the completion of the proposed sale.
pool.text: that the price set out in the notice was fictitious or not fixed in good faith;

pool.heading: Remedy after the completion of the proposed sale.
pool.text: that at the time of, and for three weeks after, the publication of the notice, the person seeking to enforce the right was absent from the district and that within a reasonable time after the lapse of the said period of three weeks and before the completion of the proposed sale, he tendered to the intending vendor the purchase amount stated in the notice, and that such tender was not accepted.

pool.heading: Proceedings for enforcing the right within the time-limit.
pool.text: If a tender made under section 6 is not accepted by the intending vendor, and if the land remains unsold, the person making the tender may, on condition that he has first deposited in court the amount stated in the notice and tendered by him to the intending vendor, apply to court within the period specified in section 6, by way of petition duly stamped and verified by affidavit, for an order directing the intending vendor to sell the land to the applicant.

pool.heading: Proceedings for enforcing the right within the time-limit.
pool.text: Where the applicant alleges in his petition and proves by his affidavit, that the amount stated in the notice by the intending vendor is fictitious, the deposit of such smaller sum as may be alleged in the petition to be the reasonable price or the market value of the land, shall be deemed to be sufficient compliance with the condition in subsection (1) as to the deposit of money in court.

pool.heading: Proceedings for enforcing the right within the time-limit.
pool.text: In the event of any smaller sum being deposited under subsection (2), the court shall, without prejudice to such issues relating to the value of the land as may have to be dealt with at the inquiry into the petition, hold a preliminary inquiry as to the sufficiency of the sum deposited by the applicant, hearing such evidence as it may deem necessary for this purpose.

pool.heading: Proceedings for enforcing the right within the time-limit.
pool.text: Any order made by the court after an inquiry under subsection (3) shall be final and conclusive; and where such order directs any further sum to be deposited, compliance with the order shall be a condition precedent to the issue of any order nisi, interlocutory order, notice, or process, in the matter of the petition.

pool.heading: Proceedings for enforcing the right within the time-limit.
pool.text: Every petition under this section shall be disposed of according to the rules of summary procedure laid down in Chapter XXIV of the Civil Procedure Code; and in the event of the non-appearance or other default of the intending vendor, the court may, if after due inquiry it is satisfied that the application should be allowed, execute a conveyance of the property to the applicant, and the provisions of section 333 of that Code shall mutatis mutandis apply to any conveyance so executed.

pool.heading: Proceedings for enforcing the right within the time-limit.
pool.text: Any conveyance of the property, in completion of the proposed sale, executed by the intending vendor after the service on him of an order nisi or interlocutory order and before the final order is made in any proceedings taken under this section, shall be null and void and of no effect whatsoever in law.

pool.heading: Cases in which the right is permitted.
pool.text: The right of pre-emption shall not be exercised except in a case where the property which is to be sold consists of an undivided share or interest in immovable property, and shall in no case be permitted where such property is held in sole ownership by the intending vendor.

pool.heading: Time-limit for exercising the right by private treaty.
pool.text: Within three weeks of the date of publication of a notice under section 5, any person to whom the right of pre-emption is reserved by this Ordinance, may either tender the amount stated in such notice and buy the property from the intending vendor, or enter into an agreement to buy it.

pool.heading: Time-limit for exercising the right by private treaty.
pool.text: Any conveyance of the property executed by the intending vendor within the period of three weeks specified in subsection (1), in completion of a sale of which he has given notice under section 5 or of a sale to any person other than one to whom the right of pre-emption is reserved by this Ordinance, shall be null and void and of no effect whatsoever in law.

pool.heading: Mode of publication of notice.
pool.text: Notice of an intention or proposal to sell to any person not entitled to the right of pre-emption under this Ordinance any property to which section 4 applies shall be signed by the intending vendor before a notary public. The notice shall be attested in triplicate, but the registration of it shall not be obligatory.

pool.heading: Mode of publication of notice.
pool.text: The notice shall set out the actual price offered by the prospective purchaser, but it shall not be necessary to disclose in addition the name of the prospective purchaser.

pool.heading: Mode of publication of notice.
pool.text: A certified copy of the notice shall be forwarded forthwith by the intending vendor to the Mayor or Chairman, as the case may be, of the local authority within whose administrative limits the land is situated.

pool.heading: Mode of publication of notice.
pool.text: The Mayor or Chairman to whom the certified copy is forwarded shall record the particulars set out therein in a register to be kept by him for that purpose, and shall cause such certified copy to be posted immediately on the notice-board of his office.

pool.heading: Mode of publication of notice.
pool.text: A certificate under the hand of the officer that the notice has been duly posted on his notice-board shall be conclusive evidence of the publication of the notice for the purposes of this Ordinance.

pool.heading: Mode of exercising right of pre-emption.
pool.text: The right of pre-emption shall not be exercised save in accordance with the provisions of this Ordinance.

pool.heading: Equality of rights of all persons entitled to pre-empt; and auction in case of competition among them.
pool.text: All co-owners and heirs within the meaning of section 3 shall be deemed to have an equal right to pre-empt any share or interest in property sold without due publication of the notice required by section 5, and there shall be no preference or precedence among them:

pool.heading: Equality of rights of all persons entitled to pre-empt; and auction in case of competition among them.
pool.text: Provided, however, that in the event of any competition among such co-owners and heirs, the court may accept the highest offer made by any of them, if such offer is also larger than the actual price paid or the market value, whichever of these is the larger.

pool.heading: Restrictions on the right of pre-emption.
pool.text: When any immovable property subject to the Thesawalamai is to be sold, the right of pre-emption over such property, that is to say, the right in preference to all other persons whomsoever to buy the property for the price proposed or at the market value, shall be restricted to the following persons or classes of persons:-

pool.heading: Restrictions on the right of pre-emption.
pool.text: the persons who are co-owners with the intending vendor of the property which is to be sold, and

pool.heading: Restrictions on the right of pre-emption.
pool.text: the persons who in the event of the intestacy of the intending vendor will be his heirs.

pool.heading: Restrictions on the right of pre-emption.
pool.text: For the purposes of this Ordinance, the term "heirs" means all descendants, ascendants and collaterals up to the third degree of succession, and includes -

pool.heading: Restrictions on the right of pre-emption.
pool.text: children, grandchildren and great-grandchildren;

pool.heading: Restrictions on the right of pre-emption.
pool.text: parents, grandparents on both the paternal and the maternal sides and great-grandparents on all sides;

pool.heading: Restrictions on the right of pre-emption.
pool.text: brothers and sisters whether of the full or of the half-blood;

pool.heading: Restrictions on the right of pre-emption.
pool.text: uncles and aunts, and nephews and nieces, both on the paternal and the maternal sides, and whether of the full or of the half-blood.
