pool.heading: Registration of a Condominium Plan Provisional Condominium Plan or a semi Condominium Plan .
pool.text: The owner of any Condominium Property any Provisional Condominium property or any semi Condominium Property as the case may be,' may make application in the prescribed form to the Registrar with the prescribed fee for the registration of a Condominium Plan, or a Provisional plan ' Condominium Plan or a semi Condominium Plan as the case may be.

pool.heading: Registration of a Condominium Plan Provisional Condominium Plan or a semi Condominium Plan .
pool.text: The owner of any land parcel on which there is a completed building capable of being subdivided under section 2 and which is certified by the General Manager of the Condominium Management Authority, to be fit for occupation or use shall, make application within the period specified in paragraph (a) or (b) as the case may be, in the prescribed form with the prescribed fee to the Registrar, for the registration of a Condominium Plan which shall accompany such application, if at any time he has sold or in agreement to sell-

pool.heading: Registration of a Condominium Plan Provisional Condominium Plan or a semi Condominium Plan .
pool.text: within eighteen months from the date of such first sale or in agreement to sell or three months from the date of the completion of such building whichever is earlier;

pool.heading: Registration of a Condominium Plan Provisional Condominium Plan or a semi Condominium Plan .
pool.text: within six months from the date of completion of such building, if the sale or agreement to sell of any parcel of the building, of which the first of such sale or agreement to sell took place, after the date of completion of such building.

pool.heading: Registration of a Condominium Plan Provisional Condominium Plan or a semi Condominium Plan .
pool.text: (a) The owner shall make an application to the General Manager of the Condominium Management Authority, to obtain an extension of the time period specified under subsection (2).

pool.heading: Registration of a Condominium Plan Provisional Condominium Plan or a semi Condominium Plan .
pool.text: Where an application is made under paragraph (a) by the owner to the General Manager by the Condominium Management Authority may, in consultation of the Registrar grant an extension for a further period not exceeding six months.

pool.heading: Registration of a Condominium Plan Provisional Condominium Plan or a semi Condominium Plan .
pool.text: Any person who contravenes the provisions of subsection (2) or subsection (3) as the case may be shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction after summary trial before a Magistrate to a fine not exceeding rupees fifty thousand and to a further fine not exceeding rupees one thousand for each day the offence continues to be committed, after such conviction.".

pool.heading: Registration of Condominium plans. Plans of redivision of amalgamation and appeals against refusals.

pool.heading: Registration of Condominium plans. Plans of redivision of amalgamation and appeals against refusals.
pool.text: Where the Registrar refuses to register the Condominium Plan or the Provisional Condominium Plan or the Semi Condominium Plan or the Plan of amendment, or the plan of redivision or the Plan of amalgamation or the Plan of additions as the case may be, he shall make an order of refusal and record his reasons for such order in the prescribed register and shall endorse the words "Registration of condominium title refused" or "Registration of provisional condominium title refused" or "Registration of semi condominium title refused", as the case may be, on the instruments and on the application made by the person who presented the application for such registration and shall, without payment or unnecessary delay issue to the applicant a copy of the reasons so recorded.

pool.heading: Registration of Condominium plans. Plans of redivision of amalgamation and appeals against refusals.
pool.text: An appeal shall lie from every order made by the Registrar refusing to register the Condominium Plan or the Provisional Condominium Plan, or the Semi Condominium Plan, or the Plan of amendment, or the Plan of re-division or the Plan of amalgamation or the Plan of additions and the provisions in section 38 of the Registration of Documents Ordinance shall, mutatis mutandis apply in relation to such appeal.

pool.text: Any cadastral map, plan or any other plan or map prepared in accordance with any written law. Purporting to be a true copy of such a plan or map and purporting to be signed by the surveyor general or any officer acting on his behalf shall be admissible evidence in all cases and for all purposes instead of the original and may be taken as prima facie evidence of the truth of the facts stated there in as being that of the original and it shall not be necessary to prove that such copy was infact signed or authenticated by the surveyor-general or such officer nor that it is a true copy. pool.heading: Professional misconduct
pool.text: For the purposes of this Part a registered surveyor shall be guilty of professional misconduct if he is found in any proceedings or appeal (a) to have been negligent or incompetent in the conduct of any survey;

pool.heading: Professional misconduct
pool.text: to have failed to comply with any guidelines or directions pertaining to the practice of surveying of the requirements pertaining to the preparation of and maintenance of survey plans and cadastral maps as are prescribed;

pool.heading: Professional misconduct
pool.text: to have certified as to the accuracy of any survey or any plan or map in relation to a survey-

pool.heading: Professional misconduct
pool.text: where such surveyor being an officer in the service of the Government has conducted the survey of certified the plan or map without exercising due care or caution

pool.heading: Professional misconduct
pool.text: where such surveyor being a registered licensed surveyor;

pool.heading: Professional misconduct
pool.text: (A) has conducted such survey or certified the plan or map, without exercising due care or caution.

pool.heading: Professional misconduct
pool.text: (B) without having personally conducted such survey, has caused it to be done by another registered licensed surveyor and has not taken sufficient measures to ensure the accuracy of the field work and office work of such other surveyor

pool.heading: Professional misconduct
pool.text: without having personally conducted such survey, has caused it to be done by a person other than by a registered licensed surveyor.

pool.heading: Professional misconduct
pool.text: (D)has certified to the accuracy of such survey, map or plan knowing it to be defective;

pool.heading: Professional misconduct
pool.text: to have made any entry in any field book or other record that purports to have been derived from actual observation or measurement in the field where in fact it has not been so derived.

pool.heading: Professional misconduct
pool.text: to have supplied to the Surveyor-General or any other registered surveyor any erroneous information in relation to any survey, survey mark, or boundary, knowing that information to be erroneous in any material particular;

pool.heading: Professional misconduct
pool.text: to have failed, without reasonable cause, to perform any duty imposed on a registered surveyor under this Act or comply with any condition subject to which he was allowed by the Council to practise land surveying.

pool.heading: Professional misconduct
pool.text: For the purposes of determining whether or not any registered surveyor is guilty of professional misconduct the fact that any survey plan or map may have been approved by or on behalf of the Surveyor-General shall not be relevant.-

pool.heading: Copies purporting to be authenticated by the surveyor general admissible in evidence instead of originals.
pool.text: Any cadastral map, plan or any other plan or map prepared in accordance with any written law. Purporting to be a true copy of such a plan or map and purporting to be signed by the surveyor general or any officer acting on his behalf shall be admissible evidence in all cases and for all purposes instead of the original and may be taken as prima facie evidence of the truth of the facts stated there in as being that of the original and it shall not be necessary to prove that such copy was infact signed or authenticated by the surveyor-general or such officer nor that it is a true copy. Nor that the facts reflected there in are accurate. Until evidence to the contrary shall have first been given.

hierarchy.label: TRANSFER OF SHARES AND DEBENTURES, EVIDENCE OF TITLE &C .

pool.heading: Certification of transfers.
pool.text: an instrument of transfer shall be deemed to be certified if it bears the words "certificate lodged" or words to the like effect;

hierarchy.label: TRANSFER OF SHARES AND DEBENTURES, EVIDENCE OF TITLE &C .

pool.heading: Certification of transfers.
pool.text: the certification of an instrument of transfer shall be deemed to be made by a company, where -

hierarchy.label: TRANSFER OF SHARES AND DEBENTURES, EVIDENCE OF TITLE &C .

pool.heading: Certification of transfers.
pool.text: the person issuing the instrument is a person authorised to issue certificated instruments of transfer on the company's behalf; and

hierarchy.label: TRANSFER OF SHARES AND DEBENTURES, EVIDENCE OF TITLE &C .

pool.heading: Certification of transfers.
pool.text: the certification is signed by a person authorised to certify transfers on the company's behalf or by an officer or servant either of the company or of a body corporate so authorised;

hierarchy.label: TRANSFER OF SHARES AND DEBENTURES, EVIDENCE OF TITLE &C .

pool.heading: Certification of transfers.
pool.text: a certification shall be deemed to be signed by any person where -

hierarchy.label: TRANSFER OF SHARES AND DEBENTURES, EVIDENCE OF TITLE &C .

pool.heading: Certification of transfers.
pool.text: it purports to be authenticated by his signature or initials, whether handwritten or not; and

hierarchy.label: TRANSFER OF SHARES AND DEBENTURES, EVIDENCE OF TITLE &C .

pool.heading: Certification of transfers.
pool.text: it is not shown that the signature or initials was or were placed there neither by himself nor by any person authorised to use the signature or initials for the purpose of certifying transfers on the company's behalf.

hierarchy.label: TRANSFER OF SHARES AND DEBENTURES, EVIDENCE OF TITLE &C .

pool.heading: Transfer by legal representative.
pool.text: A transfer of the shares or other interests of a deceased shareholder of a company made by his legal representative shall, although the legal representative is not himself a shareholder of the company, be as valid as if he had been such a shareholder at the time of the execution of the instrument of transfer.

hierarchy.label: TRANSFER OF SHARES AND DEBENTURES, EVIDENCE OF TITLE &C .

pool.heading: Transfer of lands and parcels.
pool.text: The owners of all the parcels may by special resolution at a meeting convened by the management corporation direct the management corporation to accept a transfer (a) of any land or part thereof, free from any encumbrances except those created by statute and subsisting servitudes so that such land or part thereof shall form part of the common elements in favour of all the owners of the parcels; or

pool.heading: Transfer of lands and parcels.
pool.text: of any parcel, including the undivided share in the common elements appurtenant to that parcel, free from any encumbrances except those created by statute and subsisting servitudes so that such parcel shall form part of the common elements in favour of the owners of the other parcels shown in the same registered Condominium Plan.

pool.heading: Transfer of lands and parcels.
pool.text: The transfer lodged for registration shall contain a request to the Registrar that such land or part thereof, or the parcel transferred, as the case may be, be included as part of the common elements.

pool.heading: Transfer of lands and parcels.
pool.text: Upon registration of such transfer the Registrar shall (a) enter a memorial of the transfer on the folio of the land register and the registered Condominium Plan comprising the Condominium Property; and

pool.heading: Transfer of lands and parcels.
pool.text: amend the registered Condominium Plan in such manner as the Registrar may think fit so as to show thereon the transferred land or part thereof or the parcel transferred as forming part of the common elements, and in the case where the parcel is transferred, to delete the share value of that parcel shown on the registered Condominium Plan and decrease the total number of share value equal to the aggregate share entitlement by amending such aggregate number shown on the registered Condominium Plan and

pool.heading: Transfer of lands and parcels.
pool.text: upon such amendment being made, notify the management corporation of the aggregate share entitlement and the consequent share entitlement of each owner of a parcel.

pool.heading: Transfer of lands and parcels.
pool.text: The registered transfer shall have the following effect:

pool.heading: Transfer of lands and parcels.
pool.text: the owners of all the parcels shall hold the common elements (including the transferred land or parcel) as tenants in common proportional to their respective share value shown on the Condominium Plan amended pursuant to subsection (3), and for the same term and tenure and subject to the same covenants, conditions and encumbrances which the owner of all the parcels held immediately prior to the registration of the transfer, and where any parcel is then subject to a registered mortgage, charge, lease or sub-lease, or any other encumbrances, the undivided share in the transferred land or transferred parcel forming the additional common elements held by the owner of the said parcel shall in all respects be subject to the same mortgage, charge, lease or sub-lease or any other encumbrances without any further assurance; and

pool.heading: Transfer of lands and parcels.
pool.text: the transferred land or part thereof, or the transferred parcel, as the case may be, shall form part of the common elements and the provisions of this Law applicable to common elements as varied by this section shall apply to such transferred land or parcel.

pool.heading: Transfer of lands and parcels.
pool.text: The provisions in sections 40, 41, 42, 43,44, 45, 46, 47, 48 and 49 of the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998 shall apply, mutatis mutandis, in relation to the execution of any instrument and for the registration of such instruments.

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: Every company which has issued shares shall maintain a share register that records the shares issued by the company, and which includes-

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: the name and the latest known address of each person who is or has within the last ten years been a shareholder;

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: the number of shares of each class held by each shareholder within the last ten years; and

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: the date of any-

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: issue of shares to;

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: repurchase or redemption of shares from; or

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: transfer of shares by or to,

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: each shareholder within the last ten years, and in relation to the transfer, the name of the person to or from whom the shares were transferred.

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: Where a company fails to comply with the requirements of subsection (1)-

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: the company shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding two hundred thousand rupees; and

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: every officer of the company who is in default shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding one hundred thousand rupees.

pool.heading: Registrar may strike off defunct company from register.
pool.text: Where the Registrar has reasonable cause to believe that a company is not carrying on business or is in operation, he may send to the company by post a letter inquiring whether the company is carrying on business or is in operation.

pool.heading: Registrar may strike off defunct company from register.
pool.text: Where the Registrar does not within one month of the date of sending the letter referred to in subsection (1) receive any answer thereto, he shall within ten working days from the date of expiry of the said period of one month, send to the company a letter by registered post referring to the first letter, and stating that no answer thereto has been received, and that if an answer is not received to the second letter within one month from the date thereof, a notice will be published in the Gazette with a view to striking off the name of the company from the register.

pool.heading: Registrar may strike off defunct company from register.
pool.text: Where the Registrar under the provisions of subsection (2), either receives an answer to the effect that the company is not carrying on business or in operation, or does not within one month after sending the second letter receive an answer, he may publish in the Gazette, and send to the company by post, a notice that at the expiration of three months from the date of that notice the name of the company specified therein will, unless cause is shown to the contrary, be stuck off the register and be dissolved.

pool.heading: Registrar may strike off defunct company from register.
pool.text: Where in the winding up of a company the Registrar has reasonable cause to believe either that no liquidator is acting, or that the affairs of the company are fully wound up, and the returns required to be made by the liquidator under the provisions of this Act have not been made for a period of six consecutive months, the Registrar shall publish in the Gazette and send to the company or the liquidator, if any, a notice as is referred to in subsection (3).

pool.heading: Registrar may strike off defunct company from register.
pool.text: Upon the expiration of the period specified in the notice given under the provisions of subsection (4), the Registrar may, unless cause to the contrary is previously shown by the company, strike off the name of the company form the register, and shall publish notice thereof in the Gazette, and upon such publication the company shall be dissolved:

pool.heading: Registrar may strike off defunct company from register.
pool.text: Provided that-

pool.heading: Registrar may strike off defunct company from register.
pool.text: the liability, if any, of every director, manager and shareholder of the company shall continue and may be enforced as if the company had not been dissolved; and

pool.heading: Registrar may strike off defunct company from register.
pool.text: nothing in the provisions of this subsection shall affect the power of the court to wind up a company the name of which has been struck off the register.

pool.heading: Registrar may strike off defunct company from register.
pool.text: Where a company or any shareholder or creditor thereof is aggrieved by the company having been struck off the register, the court on an application made by the company or shareholder or creditor, as the case may be, before the expiration of five years from the publication in the Gazette of the notice referred to in subsection (5) may, if satisfied, that the company was at the time of the striking off carrying on business or in operation, or otherwise that it is just that the name of the company should be restored to the register, order the name of the company to be restored to the register, and upon a certified copy of the order being delivered to the Registrar for registration, the company shall be deemed to have continued in existence as if its name had not been struck off the register, and the court may by such order give such directions and make such provisions as to it seems just for placing the company and all other persons in the same position as nearly as may be, as if the name of the company had not been struck off the register.

pool.heading: Registrar may strike off defunct company from register.
pool.text: A notice to be sent under the provisions of this section to a liquidator may be addressed to the liquidator at his last known place of business, and a letter or notice to be sent under the provisions of this section to a company may be addressed to the company at its registered office, or where no office has been registered, to the care of some officer of the company at the most recent address recorded for that person in the annual returns or any other documents sent to the Registrar by the company.

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: Where a company creates a charge to which this section applies, it shall be the duty of the company within the time specified in subsection (3), to cause a copy of the instrument by which the charge is created or evidenced, to be delivered to the Registrar for registration under this Act. The copy of the instrument shall be accompanied by a certificate in the prescribed form issued by a director or secretary of the company or an attorney-at law, verifying the copy as a true copy and containing the prescribed particulars of the charge.

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: This section shall apply to the following charges:-

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: a charge for the purpose of securing any issue of debentures;

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: a charge on uncalled share capital of the company;

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: a charge created or evidenced by an instrument which, if executed by an individual, would require registration as a bill of sale;

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: a charge on land wherever situated, or on any interest in land;

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: a charge on book debts of the company;

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: a floating charge on the undertaking or property of the company;

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: a charge on calls made but not paid;

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: a charge on a ship or aircraft or any share in a ship or aircraft;

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: a charge on goodwill or intellectual property within the meaning of the Intellectual Property Act, No. 36 of 2003; and

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: a trust receipt to which section 4 of the Trust Receipts Ordinance (Cap. 86) applies or an inland trust receipt within the meaning of the Inland Trust Receipts Act, No. 14 of 1990.

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: An instrument which is required to be registered under this section shall-

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: in the case of instruments executed in Sri Lanka, be registered within twenty - one working days of the date of execution of the instrument; or

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: in the case of an instrument executed outside Sri Lanka, be registered within three months of the date of execution of the instrument.

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: Where a charge is created in Sri Lanka but comprises of property outside Sri Lanka, the instrument creating or purporting to create the charge may be sent for registration under the provisions of this section, notwithstanding that further proceedings may be necessary to make the charge valid or effectual according to the law of the country in which the property is situated.

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: Where a negotiable instrument has been given to secure the payment of any book debts of a company, the deposit of the instrument for the purpose of securing an advance to the company, shall not for the purposes of this section, be treated as a charge on those book debts.

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: The holding of debentures entitling the holder to a charge on land shall not for the purposes of this section, be treated as an interest in land.

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: Where a series of debentures containing or giving by reference to any other instrument any charge to the benefit of which the debenture holder of that series are entitled pari passu is created by a company, it shall for the purposes of this section be sufficient if, within fifteen working days from the date of execution of the deed containing the charge or if there is no such deed, from the date of execution of any debentures of the series, the following particulars:-

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: the total amount secured by the whole series;

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: the dates of the resolutions authorising the issue of the series and the date of the covering deed, if any, by which the security is created or defined;

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: a general description of the property charged; and

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: the names of the trustees, if any, for the debenture holders,

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: together with a copy of the deed containing the charge verified in the prescribed manner, or if there is no such deed, one of the debentures of the series, are delivered to or received by the Registrar:

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: Provided that, where more than one issue is made of debentures in the series, there shall be sent to the Registrar for entry in the register particulars of the date and amount of each issue. An omission to send such particulars shall not affect the validity of the debentures issued.

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: Where any commission, allowance or discount has been paid or made either directly or indirectly by a company to any person, in consideration of his-

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: subscribing or agreeing to subscribe whether absolutely or conditionally, for any debentures of the company; or

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: procuring or agreeing to procure subscriptions whether absolute or conditional, for any such debentures,

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: the particulars required to be sent for registration under the provisions of this section shall include particulars as to the amount or rate per centum of the commission, discount or allowance so paid or made. An omission to send such particulars shall not affect the validity of the debentures issued.

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: The deposit of any debentures as security for any debt of the company shall not for the purposes of subsection (8), be treated as the issue of the debentures at a discount.

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: Registration of a charge under this section may be effected on the application of any person interested in it. Where registration is effected on the application of a person other than the company, that person shall be entitled to recover from the company the amount of any fees paid by him to the Registrar.

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: Where any company fails to send to the Registrar for registration the particulars of any charge created by the company or of the issue of debentures of a series which requires registration under this section, then, unless the registration has been affected on the application of some other person-

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: the company shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding fifty thousand rupees; and

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: every officer of the company who is in default shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding fifty thousand rupees.

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: The provisions of this section shall be in addition to and not in substitution of any other written law relating to the registration of any document or instrument creating or purporting to create a charge on any property, whether movable or immovable.

pool.heading: Registration of charges created by companies registered in Sri Lanka.
pool.text: For the purpose of this Part of this Act, "charge" includes a mortgage.

pool.heading: Registration of transfer at the request of transferor.
pool.text: On the application of the transferor of any share or other interest in a company, the company shall enter in its share register the name of the transferee in the same manner and subject to the same conditions, as if the application for the entry were made by the transferee.

hierarchy.label: TRANSFER OF SHARES AND DEBENTURES, EVIDENCE OF TITLE &C .

pool.heading: Offences by officers of companies in liquidation.
pool.text: Where any person being a past or present officer of a company which at the time of the commission of the alleged offence is being wound up whether by or under the supervision of the court or voluntarily, or is subsequently ordered to be wound up by the court or subsequently passes a resolution for voluntary winding up-

hierarchy.label: OFFENCES ANTECEDENT TO OR IN THE COURSE OF WINDING UP

pool.heading: Offences by officers of companies in liquidation.
pool.text: does not to the best of his knowledge and belief fully and truly make known to the liquidator all the property, movable and immovable, of the company, and how and to whom and for what consideration and when the company disposed of any part thereof, except such part as has been disposed of in the ordinary course of the business of the company;

hierarchy.label: OFFENCES ANTECEDENT TO OR IN THE COURSE OF WINDING UP

pool.heading: Offences by officers of companies in liquidation.
pool.text: does not deliver to the liquidator or as he directs, all such part of the movable and immovable property of the company as in his custody or under his control, and which he is required by law to deliver;

hierarchy.label: OFFENCES ANTECEDENT TO OR IN THE COURSE OF WINDING UP

pool.heading: Offences by officers of companies in liquidation.
pool.text: does not deliver to the liquidator or as he directs, all books and papers in his custody or under his control belonging to the company and which he is required by law to deliver;

hierarchy.label: OFFENCES ANTECEDENT TO OR IN THE COURSE OF WINDING UP

pool.heading: Offences by officers of companies in liquidation.
pool.text: makes any material omission in any statement relating to the affairs of the company;

hierarchy.label: OFFENCES ANTECEDENT TO OR IN THE COURSE OF WINDING UP

pool.heading: Offences by officers of companies in liquidation.
pool.text: knowing or believing that a false debt has been proved by any person under the winding up, fails for the period of one month to inform the liquidator thereof;

hierarchy.label: OFFENCES ANTECEDENT TO OR IN THE COURSE OF WINDING UP

pool.heading: Offences by officers of companies in liquidation.
pool.text: after the date of commencement of the winding up, prevents the production of any book or paper affecting or relating to the property or affairs of the company;

hierarchy.label: OFFENCES ANTECEDENT TO OR IN THE COURSE OF WINDING UP

pool.heading: Offences by officers of companies in liquidation.
pool.text: after the date of commencement of the winding up or at any meeting of the creditors of the company within the twelve months immediately prior to the date of commencement of the winding up, attempts to account for any part of the property of the company by factious losses or expenses;

hierarchy.label: OFFENCES ANTECEDENT TO OR IN THE COURSE OF WINDING UP

pool.heading: Offences by officers of companies in liquidation.
pool.text: has within the twelve months immediately prior to the date of commencement of the winding up or at any time thereafter, by any false representation or other fraud, obtained any property for or on behalf of the company on credit which the company does not subsequently pay for;

hierarchy.label: OFFENCES ANTECEDENT TO OR IN THE COURSE OF WINDING UP

pool.heading: Offences by officers of companies in liquidation.
pool.text: within the twelve months immediately prior to the date of commencement of the winding up or at any time thereafter, under the false pretense that the company is carrying on its business, obtains on credit for or on behalf of the company, any property which the company does not subsequently pay for; or

hierarchy.label: OFFENCES ANTECEDENT TO OR IN THE COURSE OF WINDING UP

pool.heading: Offences by officers of companies in liquidation.
pool.text: is guilty of any false representation or other fraud for the purpose of obtaining the consent of the creditors of the company or any of them, to an agreement with reference to the affairs of the company or to the winding up,

hierarchy.label: OFFENCES ANTECEDENT TO OR IN THE COURSE OF WINDING UP

pool.heading: Offences by officers of companies in liquidation.
pool.text: shall be guilty of an offence and shall on conviction, in the case of the offences referred to in paragraphs (h), (i) and (j), be liable to a fine not exceeding one million rupees or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding five years or to both such fine and imprisonment, and in the case of any other offence under the provisions of this subsection, be liable to a fine not exceeding five hundred thousand rupees or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding two years or to both such fine and imprisonment:

hierarchy.label: OFFENCES ANTECEDENT TO OR IN THE COURSE OF WINDING UP

pool.heading: Offences by officers of companies in liquidation.
pool.text: Provided that it shall be a good defence to a charge under the provisions of paragraphs (a), (b), (c), (d) and (i), for the accused to prove that he had no intent to defraud, and to a charge under the provisions of paragraph (f), to prove that he had no intent to conceal the state of affairs of the company or to defeat the law.

hierarchy.label: OFFENCES ANTECEDENT TO OR IN THE COURSE OF WINDING UP

pool.heading: Offences by officers of companies in liquidation.
pool.text: For the purposes of this section, the expression "officer" shall include any person in accordance with whose directions or instructions the directors of a company have been accustomed to act.

hierarchy.label: OFFENCES ANTECEDENT TO OR IN THE COURSE OF WINDING UP

pool.heading: Registration of instrument of association.
pool.text: The instrument of association of a building society shall, after it has been approved by the Commissioner, be delivered to the Commissioner who shall retain and register such instrument upon payment of the prescribed fee.

pool.heading: Registration of instrument of association.
pool.text: All sums paid as fees under subsection (1) shall be credited to the National Housing Fund-

pool.heading: Index of shareholders.
pool.text: Every company having more than fifty shareholders shall, (unless the share register is in such a form as to constitute in itself an index) keep an index of the names of the shareholders of the company and shall within ten working days from the date on which any alteration is made in the share register, make any necessary alteration in the index.

pool.heading: Index of shareholders.
pool.text: The index shall in respect of each shareholder, contain sufficient indication enabling the account of that shareholder in the register to be readily found.

pool.heading: Index of shareholders.
pool.text: Where an index kept under this section contains the name of a company to which subsection (2) of section 129 applies, there shall be annexed to the index all written notices given by that company relating to the person or persons for whose benefit the shares registered in the name of that company are held in trust.

pool.heading: Index of shareholders.
pool.text: Where a company fails to comply with subsection (1), subsection (2) or subsection (3)-

pool.heading: Index of shareholders.
pool.text: the company shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding one hundred thousand rupees; and

pool.heading: Index of shareholders.
pool.text: every officer of the company who is in default shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding fifty thousand rupees.

pool.heading: Documents and particulars to be delivered to Registrar by overseas companies.
pool.text: Every company incorporated outside Sri Lanka which after the appointed date, establishes a place of business within Sri Lanka, shall within one month from the date of establishment of its place of business, deliver to the Registrar for purpose of registration-

pool.heading: Documents and particulars to be delivered to Registrar by overseas companies.
pool.text: a certified copy of the charter, statues or memorandum and articles of the company, or other instrument constituting or defining the constitution of the company, and where that instrument is not in an official language of Sri Lanka or in English, a translation of that instrument in such language as may be specified by the Registrar;

pool.heading: Documents and particulars to be delivered to Registrar by overseas companies.
pool.text: a list of the directors of the company, containing such particulars with respect to the directors as are by this Act required to be contained with respect to directors, in the register of the directors of a company;

pool.heading: Documents and particulars to be delivered to Registrar by overseas companies.
pool.text: the names and addresses of one or more persons resident in Sri Lanka authorized to accept on behalf of the company, service of documents and of any notices required to be served on the company;

pool.heading: Documents and particulars to be delivered to Registrar by overseas companies.
pool.text: a statement containing the full address of-

pool.heading: Documents and particulars to be delivered to Registrar by overseas companies.
pool.text: the registered or principal office of the company; and

pool.heading: Documents and particulars to be delivered to Registrar by overseas companies.
pool.text: the principal place of business of the company within Sri Lanka;

pool.heading: Documents and particulars to be delivered to Registrar by overseas companies.
pool.text: a certified copy, certified of recent date, of any document effecting or evidencing the incorporation of the company.

pool.heading: Documents and particulars to be delivered to Registrar by overseas companies.
pool.text: The Registrar may upon sufficient cause being shown by the defaulting company, extend the period of one month specified in subsection (1).

pool.heading: Documents and particulars to be delivered to Registrar by overseas companies.
pool.text: Every company incorporated outside Sri Lanka which, on or before the appointed date, establishes or has established a place of business within Sri Lanka shall, subject to subsection (4), within a period of one month from that date, deliver to the Registrar for registration, the documents and particulars specified in subsection (1).

pool.heading: Documents and particulars to be delivered to Registrar by overseas companies.
pool.text: Where an overseas company has established a place of business within Sri Lanka before the appointed date, and has complied with the requirements of Part XIII of the Companies Act, No. 17 of 1982 in relation to the delivery to the Registrar, of documents and particulars -

pool.heading: Documents and particulars to be delivered to Registrar by overseas companies.
pool.text: such company shall be deemed to have complied with subsection (3); and

pool.heading: Documents and particulars to be delivered to Registrar by overseas companies.
pool.text: the Registrar shall enter on the register of overseas companies, the documents and particulars delivered under Part XIII of the Companies Act, No. 17 of 1982, and issue a certificate of registration to such overseas company.

pool.heading: Documents and particulars to be delivered to Registrar by overseas companies.
pool.text: The Registrar may upon receipt of the documents referred to in subsections (1) or (3), as the case may be, register the company as a registered overseas company and enter its name in the register of overseas companies. A certificate of registration shall be issued to every registered overseas company, upon its registration.

pool.heading: Documents and particulars to be delivered to Registrar by overseas companies.
pool.text: The Registrar may extend the period of one month referred to in subsection (3), if it appears to him expedient to do so having regard to the circumstances of any particular case.

pool.heading: Documents and particulars to be delivered to Registrar by overseas companies.
pool.text: A company incorporated outside Sri Lanka shall not establish a place of business within Sri Lanka or be registered as an overseas company, where the business being carried on by that company does not conform to the stipulations made by or under the Exchange Control Act.

pool.heading: Statutory declaration of solvency in case of proposal to wind up voluntarily.
pool.text: Where it is proposed to wind up a company voluntarily, the directors of the company or in the case of a company having more than two directors the majority of the directors may at a meeting of the directors, make a statutory declaration to the effect that they have made a full inquiry into the affairs of the company and that they are of the opinion that the company will be able to pay its debts in full within such period not exceeding twelve moths, from the date of commencement of the winding up as may be specified in the declaration.

pool.heading: Statutory declaration of solvency in case of proposal to wind up voluntarily.
pool.text: A declaration made under the provisions of subsection (1) shall have no effect for the purposes of this Act, unless-

pool.heading: Statutory declaration of solvency in case of proposal to wind up voluntarily.
pool.text: it is made within the five weeks immediately preceding the date of the passing of the resolution for winding up of the company and is delivered to the Registrar for registration by that date; and

pool.heading: Statutory declaration of solvency in case of proposal to wind up voluntarily.
pool.text: it embodies a statement of the company's assets and liabilities as at the latest practicable date before the making of such declaration.

pool.heading: Statutory declaration of solvency in case of proposal to wind up voluntarily.
pool.text: A winding up in the case of which a declaration has been made and delivered in accordance with the provisions of this section, is in this Act referred to as "a shareholders' voluntary winding up", and a winding up in the case of which a declaration has not been so made and delivered, is in this Act referred to as "a creditors' voluntary winding up".

pool.heading: Register of directors and secretaries.
pool.text: Every company shall keep at its registered office or at such other place as may be notified to the Registrar under section 116, a register of its directors and secretaries containing with respect to each of them, the following particulars:-

pool.heading: Register of directors and secretaries.
pool.text: in the case of an individual, the present name and surname, any former name or surname, usual residential address and business occupation;

pool.heading: Register of directors and secretaries.
pool.text: in the case of a secretary which is a corporation, its corporate name and registered or principal office.

pool.heading: Register of directors and secretaries.
pool.text: The company shall ensure that notice in the prescribed form of-

pool.heading: Register of directors and secretaries.
pool.text: a change in the directors or the secretary of the company; or

pool.heading: Register of directors and secretaries.
pool.text: a change in the particulars contained in the register in respect of a director or secretary of the company, is delivered to the Registrar for registration.

pool.heading: Register of directors and secretaries.
pool.text: A notice under subsection (2) shall-

pool.heading: Register of directors and secretaries.
pool.text: specify the date of the change;

pool.heading: Register of directors and secretaries.
pool.text: in the case of the appointment of a new director or secretary, have annexed to the notice the form of consent and certificate required under section 203 or subsection (2) of section 211, as the case may be; and

pool.heading: Register of directors and secretaries.
pool.text: be delivered to the Registrar within twenty working days of-

pool.heading: Register of directors and secretaries.
pool.text: the change occurring, in the case of the appointment or resignation of a director or secretary; or

pool.heading: Register of directors and secretaries.
pool.text: the company first becoming aware of the change, in the case of the death of a director or secretary or a change in the particulars contained in the register in respect of a director or secretary.

pool.heading: Register of directors and secretaries.
pool.text: Where a company fails to comply with this section-

pool.heading: Register of directors and secretaries.
pool.text: the company shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding one hundred thousand rupees; and

pool.heading: Register of directors and secretaries.
pool.text: every officer of the company who is in default shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding fifty thousand rupees.

query_text: A dispute arises over whether a person recorded as a shareholder has title to the shares specified in a certificate signed in the company's name by a director and the secretary. What evidential effect does that share certificate have under the Companies Act?

pool.heading: Certificate to be evidence of title.
pool.text: A certificate signed under the name of the company by a director and secretary of the company specifying any shares held by any shareholder, shall be prima facie evidence of the title of the shareholder to the shares.

hierarchy.label: TRANSFER OF SHARES AND DEBENTURES, EVIDENCE OF TITLE &C .

pool.heading: Power of court to rectify register.
pool.text: Where-

pool.heading: Power of court to rectify register.
pool.text: the name of any person is without sufficient cause entered in or omitted from the share register of a company; or

pool.heading: Power of court to rectify register.
pool.text: default is made or unnecessary delay takes place in entering on the register the fact of any person having ceased to be a shareholder,

pool.heading: Power of court to rectify register.
pool.text: the person aggrieved or the company or any shareholder of the company, may make an application to the court for rectification of the register.

pool.heading: Power of court to rectify register.
pool.text: Where an application is made under this section, the court may order rectification of the register and payment by the company of any damages sustained by any party aggrieved.

pool.heading: Power of court to rectify register.
pool.text: On an application made under this section, the court may decide-

pool.heading: Power of court to rectify register.
pool.text: any question relating to the title of any person who is a party to the application to have his name entered in or omitted from the register, whether the question arises between shareholders or alleged shareholders or between shareholders or alleged shareholders on the one hand and the company on the other hand; and

pool.heading: Power of court to rectify register.
pool.text: any other question necessary or expedient to be decided for rectification of the register.

pool.heading: Power of court to rectify register.
pool.text: If the court makes an order directing the rectification of the register, the company shall within ten working days of the making of the order, deliver a copy of the order to the Registrar.

pool.heading: Power of court to rectify register.
pool.text: Where a company fails to comply with the requirements of subsection (4)-

pool.heading: Power of court to rectify register.
pool.text: the company shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding one hundred thousand rupees; and

pool.heading: Power of court to rectify register.
pool.text: every officer of the company who is in default shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding fifty thousand rupees.

pool.heading: Meaning of "shareholder".
pool.text: In this Act, the term "shareholder" means-

hierarchy.label: Part V — SHAREHOLDERS AND THEIR RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS

pool.heading: Meaning of "shareholder".
pool.text: a person whose name is entered in the share register as the holder for the time being of one or more shares in the company;

hierarchy.label: Part V — SHAREHOLDERS AND THEIR RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS

pool.heading: Meaning of "shareholder".
pool.text: until a person's name is entered in the share register, a person named as a shareholder in an application for incorporation of a company at the time of registration of the company;

hierarchy.label: Part V — SHAREHOLDERS AND THEIR RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS

pool.heading: Meaning of "shareholder".
pool.text: until a person's name is entered in the share register, a person who is entitled to have that person's name entered in the share register under a registered amalgamation proposal as a shareholder in an amalgamated company;

hierarchy.label: Part V — SHAREHOLDERS AND THEIR RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS

pool.text: until a person's name is entered in the share register, a person to whom a share has been transferred and whose name ought to be but has not been entered in the register.

hierarchy.label: Part V — SHAREHOLDERS AND THEIR RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS

pool.heading: Meaning of "shareholder".
pool.text: Where a notice of any trust has been entered in the share register in respect of any shares in a company under subsection (2) of section 129, the person for whose benefit those shares are held in trust-

hierarchy.label: Part V — SHAREHOLDERS AND THEIR RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS

pool.text: shall be deemed to be a shareholder in the company; and

hierarchy.label: Part V — SHAREHOLDERS AND THEIR RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS

pool.heading: Meaning of "shareholder".
pool.text: shall in respect of those shares, enjoy all such rights and privileges and be subject to all such duties and obligations under this Act, as if his name had been entered in the share register as the holder of those shares.

hierarchy.label: Part V — SHAREHOLDERS AND THEIR RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS

pool.heading: Meaning of "shareholder".
pool.text: Where a company has wrongfully failed to enter in the share register the name of a person to whom shares have been transfered, that person-

hierarchy.label: Part V — SHAREHOLDERS AND THEIR RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS

pool.heading: Meaning of "shareholder".
pool.text: shall be deemed to be a shareholder in the company; and

hierarchy.label: Part V — SHAREHOLDERS AND THEIR RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS

pool.heading: Meaning of "shareholder".
pool.text: shall in respect of those shares, enjoy all such rights and privileges and be subject to all such duties and obligations under this Act, as if his name had been entered in the share register as the holder of those shares.

pool.heading: Declaration and certificate to be sent by private company with annual return.
pool.text: Every private company shall send to the Registrar with its annual return-

pool.heading: Declaration and certificate to be sent by private company with annual return.
pool.text: a declaration signed by the directors of the company to the effect that to the best of their knowledge and belief, they have done all things required to be done by them by or under this Act;

pool.heading: Declaration and certificate to be sent by private company with annual return.
pool.text: a certificate signed by a director and by the secretary of the company-

pool.heading: Declaration and certificate to be sent by private company with annual return.
pool.text: that the company has not since the date of the last return or in the case of a first return, since the date of the incorporation of the company, issued any invitation to the public to subscribe for any shares or debentures of the company;

pool.heading: Declaration and certificate to be sent by private company with annual return.
pool.text: where the annual return discloses the fact that the number of shareholders of the company exceeds fifty, that the excess consists wholly of persons who under section 27, are not to be taken into account in relation to that limit.

pool.heading: Effect of certificate of amalgamation.
pool.text: On the date shown in a certificate of amalgamation-

pool.heading: Effect of certificate of amalgamation.
pool.text: the amalgamation becomes effective;

pool.heading: Effect of certificate of amalgamation.
pool.text: if it has the same name as of one of the amalgamating companies, the amalgamated company shall have the name specified in the amalgamation proposal;

pool.heading: Effect of certificate of amalgamation.
pool.text: the Registrar shall remove all particulars relating to the amalgamating companies, other than the amalgamated company, from the Register;

pool.heading: Effect of certificate of amalgamation.
pool.text: the amalgamated company succeeds to all the property, rights, powers, and privileges of each of the amalgamating companies;

pool.heading: Effect of certificate of amalgamation.
pool.text: the amalgamated company succeeds to all the liabilities and obligations of each of the amalgamating companies;

pool.heading: Effect of certificate of amalgamation.
pool.text: proceedings pending by or against an amagamating company may be continued by or against the amalgamated company;

pool.heading: Effect of certificate of amalgamation.
pool.text: a conviction, ruling, order, or judgment in favour of or against an amalgamating company, may be enforced by or against the amalgamated company;

pool.heading: Effect of certificate of amalgamation.
pool.text: the stated capital of the amalgamated company shall be the sum certified by the auditor of the amalgamated company; and

pool.heading: Effect of certificate of amalgamation.
pool.text: any provisions of the amalgamation proposal that provide for the conversion of shares or rights of shareholders in the amalgamating companies, shall have effect according to their tenor.

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: Every company which has issued shares shall maintain a share register that records the shares issued by the company, and which includes-

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: the name and the latest known address of each person who is or has within the last ten years been a shareholder;

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: the number of shares of each class held by each shareholder within the last ten years; and

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: the date of any-

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: issue of shares to;

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: repurchase or redemption of shares from; or

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: transfer of shares by or to,

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: each shareholder within the last ten years, and in relation to the transfer, the name of the person to or from whom the shares were transferred.

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: Where a company fails to comply with the requirements of subsection (1)-

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: the company shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding two hundred thousand rupees; and

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: every officer of the company who is in default shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding one hundred thousand rupees.

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: For the purposes of section 200, a director of a company has a relevant interest in a share issued by a company (whether or not the director is registered in the share register as the holder of it) if the director-

pool.text: is a beneficial owner of the share;

hierarchy.label: DISCLOSURE OF DIRECTORS' INTERESTS IN SHARES

hierarchy.label: DISCLOSURE OF DIRECTORS' INTERESTS IN SHARES

pool.text: has the power to control the exercise of any right to vote attached to the share;

hierarchy.label: DISCLOSURE OF DIRECTORS' INTERESTS IN SHARES

hierarchy.label: DISCLOSURE OF DIRECTORS' INTERESTS IN SHARES

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: under or by virtue of any trust, agreement, arrangement or understanding relating to the share (whether or not that person is a party to it) may at any time have the power to-

hierarchy.label: DISCLOSURE OF DIRECTORS' INTERESTS IN SHARES

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: exercise any right to vote attached to the share;

hierarchy.label: DISCLOSURE OF DIRECTORS' INTERESTS IN SHARES

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: control the exercise of any right to vote attached to the share;

hierarchy.label: DISCLOSURE OF DIRECTORS' INTERESTS IN SHARES

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: acquire or dispose of the share; or

hierarchy.label: DISCLOSURE OF DIRECTORS' INTERESTS IN SHARES

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: control the acquisition or disposition of the share by another person.

hierarchy.label: DISCLOSURE OF DIRECTORS' INTERESTS IN SHARES

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: Where a person (whether or not a director of the company) has a relevant interest in a share by virtue of subsection (1), and-

hierarchy.label: DISCLOSURE OF DIRECTORS' INTERESTS IN SHARES

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: that person or its directors are accustomed or under an obligation, whether legally enforceable or not, to act in accordance with the directors, instructions, or wishes of a director of the company in relation to-

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: the exercise of the right to vote attached to the share;

hierarchy.label: DISCLOSURE OF DIRECTORS' INTERESTS IN SHARES

pool.text: the control of the exercise of any right to vote attached to the share;

hierarchy.label: DISCLOSURE OF DIRECTORS' INTERESTS IN SHARES

pool.text: the acquisition or disposition of the share; or

hierarchy.label: DISCLOSURE OF DIRECTORS' INTERESTS IN SHARES

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: the exercise of the power to control the acquisition or disposition of the share by another person;

hierarchy.label: DISCLOSURE OF DIRECTORS' INTERESTS IN SHARES

pool.text: a director of the company has the power to exercise the right to vote attached to twenty per centum or more of the shares of that person;

pool.text: A person who has or may have a power referred to in paragraphs (b) to (f) of subsection (1), has a relevant interest in a share, regardless of whether the power is-

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: A reference to a power in this section includes a reference to a power that arises from or is capable of being exercised as the result of a breach of any trust, agreement, arrangement or understanding or any of them, whether or not it is legally enforceable.

pool.heading: Certification of transfers.
pool.text: The certification by a company of any instrument of transfer of shares in or debentures of the company shall be taken as a representation by the company to any person acting on the faith of such certification, that there have been produced to the company such documents as on the face of there show a prima facie title to the shares or debtors in the transferor named in the instrument of transfer, but not as a representation that the transferor has any title to the shares or debentures.

hierarchy.label: TRANSFER OF SHARES AND DEBENTURES, EVIDENCE OF TITLE &C .

pool.heading: Certification of transfers.
pool.text: Where any person acts on the faith of a false certification made by a company negligently, the company shall be under the same liability to him as if the certification had been made fraudulently.

hierarchy.label: TRANSFER OF SHARES AND DEBENTURES, EVIDENCE OF TITLE &C .

pool.heading: Certification of transfers.
pool.text: For the purposes of this section -

hierarchy.label: TRANSFER OF SHARES AND DEBENTURES, EVIDENCE OF TITLE &C .

pool.heading: Certification of transfers.
pool.text: an instrument of transfer shall be deemed to be certified if it bears the words "certificate lodged" or words to the like effect;

hierarchy.label: TRANSFER OF SHARES AND DEBENTURES, EVIDENCE OF TITLE &C .

pool.heading: Certification of transfers.
pool.text: the certification of an instrument of transfer shall be deemed to be made by a company, where -

hierarchy.label: TRANSFER OF SHARES AND DEBENTURES, EVIDENCE OF TITLE &C .

pool.heading: Certification of transfers.
pool.text: the person issuing the instrument is a person authorised to issue certificated instruments of transfer on the company's behalf; and

hierarchy.label: TRANSFER OF SHARES AND DEBENTURES, EVIDENCE OF TITLE &C .

pool.heading: Certification of transfers.
pool.text: the certification is signed by a person authorised to certify transfers on the company's behalf or by an officer or servant either of the company or of a body corporate so authorised;

hierarchy.label: TRANSFER OF SHARES AND DEBENTURES, EVIDENCE OF TITLE &C .

pool.heading: Certification of transfers.
pool.text: a certification shall be deemed to be signed by any person where -

hierarchy.label: TRANSFER OF SHARES AND DEBENTURES, EVIDENCE OF TITLE &C .

pool.heading: Certification of transfers.
pool.text: it purports to be authenticated by his signature or initials, whether handwritten or not; and

hierarchy.label: TRANSFER OF SHARES AND DEBENTURES, EVIDENCE OF TITLE &C .

pool.heading: Certification of transfers.
pool.text: it is not shown that the signature or initials was or were placed there neither by himself nor by any person authorised to use the signature or initials for the purpose of certifying transfers on the company's behalf.

hierarchy.label: TRANSFER OF SHARES AND DEBENTURES, EVIDENCE OF TITLE &C .

pool.heading: Annual return.
pool.text: Subject to the provisions of subsection (3), every company shall at least once in every year deliver to the Registrar an annual return in the prescribed form, containing the matters specified in the Fifth Schedule hereto.

pool.heading: Annual return.
pool.text: The annual return shall be completed within thirty working days from the date of the Annual General Meeting for the year, whether or not that meeting is the first or only meeting of the shareholders in the year. The company shall forthwith forward to the Registrar a copy of the return, signed both by a director and the secretary of the company.

pool.heading: Annual return.
pool.text: The provisions of this section shall not apply to a company in the year of its incorporation.

pool.heading: Annual return.
pool.text: Where a company fails to comply with the requirements of subsection (1) or subsection (2)-

pool.heading: Annual return.
pool.text: the company shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding one hundred thousand rupees; and

pool.heading: Annual return.
pool.text: every officer of the company who is in default shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding fifty thousand rupees.

pool.heading: Redemption at the option of the shareholder.
pool.text: Where a share is redeemable at the option of the holder of the share and the holder gives proper notice to the company requiring the company to redeem the share-

pool.heading: Redemption at the option of the shareholder.
pool.text: the company shall redeem the share on the date specified in the notice or if no date is specified, on the date of receipt of the notice;

pool.heading: Redemption at the option of the shareholder.
pool.text: the share is deemed to be cancelled on the date of redemption; and

pool.heading: Redemption at the option of the shareholder.
pool.text: from the date of redemption, the former shareholder ranks as an unsecured creditor of the company for the sum payable on redemption.

pool.heading: Redemption at the option of the shareholder.
pool.text: A redemption under this section is not a distribution for the purposes of section 56, but is deemed to be a distribution for the purposes of subsection (1) and subsection (3) of section 61.

pool.heading: Shareholder may require company to purchase shares.
pool.text: Where a shareholder is entitled to vote on the exercise of the power set out in paragraph (a) of subsection (1) of section 92 and the proposed alteration imposes or removes a restriction on the business or activities in which the company may engage, or set out in paragraph (b) or (c) of subsection (1) of section 92, and the shareholder resolved to exercise those powers, and-

hierarchy.label: Part V — SHAREHOLDERS AND THEIR RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS

pool.heading: Shareholder may require company to purchase shares.
pool.text: the shareholder cast all the votes attached to shares registered in the shareholder's name and having the same beneficial owner against the exercise of the power; or

hierarchy.label: Part V — SHAREHOLDERS AND THEIR RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS

pool.heading: Shareholder may require company to purchase shares.
pool.text: where the resolution to exercise the power was passed under section 144, the shareholder did not sign the resolution in respect of the shares registered in the shareholder's name and having the same beneficial owner,

hierarchy.label: Part V — SHAREHOLDERS AND THEIR RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS

pool.heading: Shareholder may require company to purchase shares.
pool.text: that shareholder shall be entitled to require the company to purchase those shares in accordance with section 94.

pool.heading: Appeals from decisions of the Board
pool.text: Where the Board disallows an application made to the Board, the applicant may, within twenty-eight days after the communication to him of the Board's decision on such application, make a written appeal from such decision to the Minister. Such appeal shall state the grounds of appeal.

hierarchy.label: Tea and Rubber Estates (Control of Fragmentation) Act No. 2 of 1958

pool.citation: Tea and Rubber Estates (Control of Fragmentation) Act, s 15(2)
pool.act_title: Tea and Rubber Estates (Control of Fragmentation) Act
pool.heading: Appeals from decisions of the Board
pool.text: Where any appeal is made under subsection (1), the Minister may either affirm the Board's decision from which the appeal is made or, having regard to the provisions of section 8, allow the application to which the Board's decision relates by consenting, as the case may be, to the transfer of ownership of the tea or rubber estate specified in such application, or to the partition by deed of such estate, or to the institution of a partition action in respect of such estate. The Minister's consent may be subject to such conditions as he may specify. The decision of the Minister shall be final and conclusive and shall not be called in question in any court.

hierarchy.label: Tea and Rubber Estates (Control of Fragmentation) Act No. 2 of 1958

pool.citation: Tea and Rubber Estates (Control of Fragmentation) Act, s 15(3)
pool.act_title: Tea and Rubber Estates (Control of Fragmentation) Act
pool.heading: Appeals from decisions of the Board
pool.text: Where on any appeal made under subsection (1) the Minister decides to affirm the Board's decision, the Permanent Secretary shall in writing inform the appellant and the Secretary of the Board that the Minister has affirmed the Board's decision.

hierarchy.label: Tea and Rubber Estates (Control of Fragmentation) Act No. 2 of 1958

pool.citation: Tea and Rubber Estates (Control of Fragmentation) Act, s 15(4)
pool.act_title: Tea and Rubber Estates (Control of Fragmentation) Act
pool.heading: Appeals from decisions of the Board
pool.text: Where the Minister allows any appeal made under subsection (1) and consents to the transfer of ownership of the tea or rubber estate to which the appeal relates, or to the partition by deed of such estate, or to the institution of a partition action in respect of such estate, the Permanent Secretary shall prepare four copies of the certificate of the Minister's consent and, if the Minister has made such consent subject to any conditions, specify those conditions in such certificate. Each such copy shall be signed by the Permanent Secretary. Of such copies the Permanent Secretary shall transmit three to the appellant and the fourth to the Secretary of the Board to be filed of record in the Board's office.

hierarchy.label: Tea and Rubber Estates (Control of Fragmentation) Act No. 2 of 1958

pool.citation: Tea and Rubber Estates (Control of Fragmentation) Act, s 15(5)
pool.act_title: Tea and Rubber Estates (Control of Fragmentation) Act
pool.heading: Appeals from decisions of the Board
pool.text: For the purposes of section 3 and section 4, the Minister's consent under the preceding provisions of this section shall be deemed to be the consent of the Board, and any conditions to which the Minister has made his consent subject shall be deemed to be conditions Imposed by the Board.

pool.heading: Certificates of consent
pool.text: Where on an application made to the Board it is decided by the Board to consent to the transfer of ownership of the tea or rubber estate to which such application relates, or the partition by deed of such estate, or the institution of a partition action in respect of such estate, the Secretary of the Board shall prepare four copies of the Board's certificate of such consent, and, if the Board has determined any conditions to which such consent is to be subject, state those conditions in such certificate. Each such copy shall be signed by the Secretary of the Board and by one of the members of the Board present at the meeting of the Board at which the decision was made to grant such consent. Of such copies the Secretary of the Board shall transmit three to the person who made the application for such consent and shall file of record the fourth in the Board's office.

pool.heading: Recovery of distributions.
pool.text: A distribution made to a shareholder at a time when the company did not, immediately after the distribution, satisfy the solvency test, may be recovered by the company from the shareholder, unless-

pool.heading: Recovery of distributions.
pool.text: the shareholder received the distribution in good faith and without knowledge of the company's failure to satisfy the solvency test;

pool.heading: Recovery of distributions.
pool.text: the shareholder has altered his position in relying on the validity of the distribution; and

pool.heading: Recovery of distributions.
pool.text: it would be unreasonable in view of the circumstances to require repayment in full at all.

pool.heading: Recovery of distributions.
pool.text: Where in relation to a distribution to which subsection (1) applies, the procedure set out in section 56 has not been followed or reasonable grounds for believing that the company would satisfy the solvency test did not exist at the time the certificate was signed, every director who-

pool.heading: Recovery of distributions.
pool.text: failed to take reasonable steps to ensure the procedure was followed; or

pool.heading: Recovery of distributions.
pool.text: signed the certificate,

pool.heading: Recovery of distributions.
pool.text: as the case may be, shall be personally liable to the company to repay to the company, so much of the distribution as the company is not able to recover from the shareholders.

pool.heading: Recovery of distributions.
pool.text: Where in an action brought against a director or a shareholder under this section, the court is satisfied that the company could by making a distribution of a lesser amount have satisfied the solvency test, the court may-

pool.heading: Recovery of distributions.
pool.text: permit the shareholder to retain; or

pool.heading: Recovery of distributions.
pool.text: relive the director from liability in respect of,

pool.heading: Recovery of distributions.
pool.text: an amount equal to the value of any distribution that could properly have been made.

pool.text: The entry of the name of a person in the share register as holder of a share shall be prima facie evidence that title to the share is vested in that person.

pool.text: In this section the expression "expert" includes an engineer, a Valuer, an accountant and any other person whose profession gives authority to a statement made by him, and for the purposes of this section, a statement shall be deemed to be included in a prospectus, if it is contained in or in any report or memorandum appearing on the face of or by reference incorporated in or issued with, such prospectus.
