pool.heading: Directors standard of care.
pool.text: A person exercising powers or performing duties as a director of a company-

pool.heading: Directors standard of care.
pool.text: shall not act in a manner which is reckless or grossly negligent; and

pool.heading: Directors standard of care.
pool.text: shall exercise the degree of skill and care that may reasonably be expected of a person of his knowledge and experience.

pool.heading: Professional misconduct
pool.text: For the purposes of this Part a registered surveyor shall be guilty of professional misconduct if he is found in any proceedings or appeal (a) to have been negligent or incompetent in the conduct of any survey;

pool.heading: Professional misconduct
pool.text: to have failed to comply with any guidelines or directions pertaining to the practice of surveying of the requirements pertaining to the preparation of and maintenance of survey plans and cadastral maps as are prescribed;

pool.heading: Professional misconduct
pool.text: to have certified as to the accuracy of any survey or any plan or map in relation to a survey-

pool.heading: Professional misconduct
pool.text: where such surveyor being an officer in the service of the Government has conducted the survey of certified the plan or map without exercising due care or caution

pool.heading: Professional misconduct
pool.text: where such surveyor being a registered licensed surveyor;

pool.heading: Professional misconduct
pool.text: (A) has conducted such survey or certified the plan or map, without exercising due care or caution.

pool.heading: Professional misconduct
pool.text: (B) without having personally conducted such survey, has caused it to be done by another registered licensed surveyor and has not taken sufficient measures to ensure the accuracy of the field work and office work of such other surveyor

pool.heading: Professional misconduct
pool.text: without having personally conducted such survey, has caused it to be done by a person other than by a registered licensed surveyor.

pool.heading: Professional misconduct
pool.text: (D)has certified to the accuracy of such survey, map or plan knowing it to be defective;

pool.heading: Professional misconduct
pool.text: to have made any entry in any field book or other record that purports to have been derived from actual observation or measurement in the field where in fact it has not been so derived.

pool.heading: Professional misconduct
pool.text: to have supplied to the Surveyor-General or any other registered surveyor any erroneous information in relation to any survey, survey mark, or boundary, knowing that information to be erroneous in any material particular;

pool.heading: Professional misconduct
pool.text: to have failed, without reasonable cause, to perform any duty imposed on a registered surveyor under this Act or comply with any condition subject to which he was allowed by the Council to practise land surveying.

pool.heading: Professional misconduct
pool.text: For the purposes of determining whether or not any registered surveyor is guilty of professional misconduct the fact that any survey plan or map may have been approved by or on behalf of the Surveyor-General shall not be relevant.-

pool.heading: Duty of directors to act in good faith and in the interests of company.
pool.text: A person exercising powers or performing duties as a director of a company shall act in good faith, and subject to subsection (2), in what that person believes to be in the interests of the company.

pool.heading: Duty of directors to act in good faith and in the interests of company.
pool.text: A director of a company which is a wholly owned subsidiary of another company may, if expressly permitted to do so by the company's articles, act in a manner which he believes is in the interest of that other company even though it may not be in the interests of the company of which he is a director.

Any person who is appointed or to his knowledge is proposed to be appointed director of a company at a time when he has attained the age of seventy years or such lower age, if any, as may be specified in the company's articles, shall give notice of his age to the company.

Provisions of subsection (1) shall not apply in relation to a person's reappointment on the termination of a previous appointment as a director of the company, where notice has been given by that person under subsection (1) on any previous occasion.
Any person who-
fails to give notice of his age as required by the provisions of subsection (1); or
acts as director under any appointment which is invalid or which has terminated by reason of his age,
shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding fifty thousand rupees.

For the purposes of paragraph (b) of subsection (3), a person who has acted as a director under an appointment which is invalid or has terminated, shall be deemed to have continued so to act throughout the period from the date of the invalid appointment or the date on which the appointment terminated, as the case may be, until the last day on which he acted thereunder.

pool.heading: Power to require information as to persons interested in shares or debentures.
pool.text: Where it appears to the Registrar that there is good reason to investigate the ownership of any shares in or debentures of a company and that it is unnecessary to appoint an inspector for the purpose, the Registrar may require any person whom he has reasonable cause to believe-

pool.heading: Power to require information as to persons interested in shares or debentures.
pool.text: to be or to have been interested in those shares or debentures; or

pool.heading: Power to require information as to persons interested in shares or debentures.
pool.text: to act or to have acted in relation to those shares or debentures as the attorney or agent of any person interested in them,

pool.heading: Power to require information as to persons interested in shares or debentures.
pool.text: to give the Registrar any information which he has or can reasonably be expected to obtain, as to the present and past interests in those shares or debentures and the names and addresses of the persons interested, and of any person who act or have acted on their behalf in relation to the shares or debentures.

pool.heading: Power to require information as to persons interested in shares or debentures.
pool.text: For the purposes of this section a person shall be deemed to have an interest in shares or debentures, if he has any right to acquire or dispose of them or of any interest in them or to vote in respect of them, or if his consent is necessary for the exercise of any rights of other persons interested in them, or if other persons interested in them can be required or are accustomed to exercise their rights in accordance with his instructions.

pool.heading: Power to require information as to persons interested in shares or debentures.
pool.text: Any person who fails to give information required of him under subsection (1), or who in giving any such information makes any statement which he knows to be false in a material particular, or recklessly makes any statement which is false in a material particular, shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding one million rupees or to an imprisonment for a term not exceeding five years or to both such fine and imprisonment.

pool.heading: Directors to comply with Act and company's articles.
pool.text: A director of a company shall not act or agree to the company acting, in a manner that contravenes any provisions of this Act, or the provisions contained in the articles of the company.

pool.heading: Court may disqualify directors.
pool.text: Where a person-

pool.heading: Court may disqualify directors.
pool.text: is prohibited from being a director of company under section 213;

pool.heading: Court may disqualify directors.
pool.text: while a director of a company, has persistently failed to comply with the provisions of this Act;

pool.heading: Court may disqualify directors.
pool.text: has been convicted of an offence of involving dishonest or fraudulent acts in a country other than Sri Lanka; or

pool.heading: Court may disqualify directors.
pool.text: was a director of a company which became insolvent and that person's conduct as a director of that company or of any other company makes that person unfit to be a director of a company,

pool.heading: Court may disqualify directors.
pool.text: the court may make an order that the person shall not, without leave of court, be a director or promoter of or in any way whether directly or indirectly be concerned or take part in the management of a company, for such period not exceeding ten years as may be specified in the order.

pool.heading: Court may disqualify directors.
pool.text: A person intending to apply for an order under this section shall give not less than ten working days' notice of that intention to the person against whom the order is sought. On the hearing of the application the person against whom the order is sought, may appear and give evidence or call witnesses.

pool.heading: Court may disqualify directors.
pool.text: An application for an order under this section may be made by the Registrar or by a liquidator or an administrator of a company of which the person against whom the order is sought was a director, or by a person who is or has been a shareholder or creditor of any such company.

pool.heading: Court may disqualify directors.
pool.text: An order may be made under this section even though the person concerned may be criminally liable in respect of the matters on the ground of which the order is to be made.

pool.heading: Court may disqualify directors.
pool.text: The Registrar of the court shall as soon as practicable after the making of an order under this section, give notice to the Registrar that the order has been made and the Registrar-

pool.heading: Court may disqualify directors.
pool.text: shall cause to be published in the Gazette the name of the person against whom the order is made; and

pool.heading: Court may disqualify directors.
pool.text: may give such further notice of the making of the order as he thinks fit.

pool.heading: Court may disqualify directors.
pool.text: Every person who acts in contravention of an order made under this section shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding one million rupees or to a term of imprisonment not exceeding five years or to both such fine and imprisonment.

pool.heading: Court may disqualify directors.
pool.text: In this section "company" includes an overseas company which carries on business in Sri Lanka.

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: Where all the shareholders of a private company agree in writing to any action which has been taken, or is to be taken by the company-

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: the taking of that action is deemed to be validly authorised by the company, notwithstanding any provision in the articles of the company to the contrary; and

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: the provisions contained in the list of sections of this Act specified in the Second Schedule hereto, shall not apply to and in relation to that action.

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.

pool.text: the issue of shares by the company;

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: the making of a distribution by the company;

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: the repurchase or redemption of shares in the company;

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: the giving of financial assistance by a company for the purpose of or in connection with the purchase of shares in the company;

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: the payment of remuneration to a director, or the making of a loan to a director, or the conferment of any other benefit on a director; or

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: the entering into a contract between an interested director and the company.

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: Where a distribution is made by a company under subsection (2) and as a consequence of making that distribution the company fails to satisfy the solvency test, such distribution shall be deemed not to have been made validly.

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.

pool.text: the shareholder received the distribution in good faith and without knowledge of the company's failure to satisfy the solvency test;

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: the shareholder has altered his position relying on the validity of such distribution; and

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: it would be unreasonable in view of the circumstances, to require repayment in full or at all.

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: Where reasonable grounds did not exist for believing that the company would be able to satisfy the solvency test after the making of a distribution which is deemed not to have been validly made, each shareholder who agreed to the making of such distribution will be personally liable to the company, to repay to the company so much of the distribution which the company is not able to recover from the shareholders to whom the distribution was made.

pool.heading: Functions of the council.
pool.text: The functions of the Council shall be-

pool.heading: Functions of the council.
pool.text: to maintain standards and procedures relating to land surveying and professional discipline among persons engaged in land surveying.

pool.heading: Functions of the council.
pool.text: to receive applications from surveyors for registration as registered surveyors, and to register such surveyors where the Council is satisfied that such surveyors possess the prescribed qualification and experience and have the ability and skills to practise land surveying;

pool.heading: Functions of the council.
pool.text: to receive applications from registered surveyors for the issue of an Annual Practicing licence and to issue such licences to such surveyors where the Council is satisfied that such surveyors possess the knowledge and skill to practise the profession of land surveying;

pool.heading: Functions of the council.
pool.text: to promote the maintenance of high standards of professional education among persons engaged in land surveying;

pool.heading: Functions of the council.
pool.text: to promote programs which provide for professional development by improving the knowledge and skills of persons practicing land surveying and who are required to obtain an Annual practicing Licence;

pool.heading: Functions of the council.
pool.text: to recognize academic and professional qualifications in land surveying, establish practical experience requirements and conduct qualifying examinations and professional interviews, for candidates for registration surveyors and for the issue of annual practicing licenses;

pool.heading: Functions of the council.
pool.text: to negotiate and administer reciprocal arrangements with the relevant authorities in foreign countries for the purpose of security uniformity and reciprocity in the education, training and recognition of persons engaged in land surveying;

pool.heading: Functions of the council.
pool.text: to co-ordinate with the institutions engaged in education and training in land surveying and land information in Sri Lanka, for the maintenance of required educational standards;

pool.heading: Functions of the council.
pool.text: to co-ordinate with other relevant organisations in Sri Lanka in the maintenance of high professional standards.

pool.heading: Avoidance of transaction.
pool.text: A transaction entered into by the company in which a director of the company is interested, may be avoided by the company at any time before the expiration of six months after the transaction, and the director's interest in it have been disclosed to all the shareholders (whether by means of the company's annual report or otherwise).

hierarchy.label: TRANSACTIONS IN WHICH A DIRECTOR IS INTERESTED

pool.heading: Avoidance of transaction.
pool.text: A transaction shall not be avoided under this section if the company receives fair value under it.

hierarchy.label: TRANSACTIONS IN WHICH A DIRECTOR IS INTERESTED

pool.heading: Avoidance of transaction.
pool.text: For the purposes of subsection (2), the question whether a company receives fair value under a transaction shall be determined on the basis of the information known to the company and to the interested director, at the time the transaction is entered into.

hierarchy.label: TRANSACTIONS IN WHICH A DIRECTOR IS INTERESTED

pool.heading: Avoidance of transaction.
pool.text: If a transaction is entered into by the company in the ordinary course of its business and on usual terms and conditions, the company shall be presumed to have received fair value under the transaction.

hierarchy.label: TRANSACTIONS IN WHICH A DIRECTOR IS INTERESTED

pool.heading: Avoidance of transaction.
pool.text: For the purposes of this section -

hierarchy.label: TRANSACTIONS IN WHICH A DIRECTOR IS INTERESTED

pool.heading: Avoidance of transaction.
pool.text: a person seeking to uphold a transaction and who knew or ought to have known of the director's interest at the time the transaction was entered into, shall have the burden of establishing fair value; and

hierarchy.label: TRANSACTIONS IN WHICH A DIRECTOR IS INTERESTED

pool.heading: Avoidance of transaction.
pool.text: in any other case, the company shall have the burden of establishing that it did not receive fair value.

hierarchy.label: TRANSACTIONS IN WHICH A DIRECTOR IS INTERESTED

pool.heading: Avoidance of transaction.
pool.text: A transaction in which a director is interested shall not be avoided on the ground of the director's interest, other than pursuant to this section or the company's articles.

pool.heading: Power to make regulations
pool.text: It shall be lawful for the Minister to make regulations (a) for the preservation and protection of such Buddhist shrines, temples, inscriptions, and monuments, (not being 'antiquities' within the meaning of the Antiquities Ordinance), as may be considered to be of historical, archaeological, or artistic interest, and for preventing the same from being defaced by inappropriate or incongruous repairs or additions;

pool.heading: Power to make regulations
pool.text: for the care and custody of articles of value belonging to temples;

pool.heading: Power to make regulations
pool.text: for the levying of contributions from the property of temples for carrying out the provisions of this Ordinance;

pool.heading: Power to make regulations
pool.text: prescribing the measures for the due safeguarding of offerings and collections made at temples;

pool.heading: Power to make regulations
pool.text: prescribing the forms and the manner in which accounts, registers and books are to be kept, the conditions for their inspection and the fees for extracts therefrom;

pool.heading: Power to make regulations
pool.text: modifying the forms in the Schedule and prescribing additional forms;

pool.heading: Power to make regulations
pool.text: prescribing the matters in which the Commissioner of Buddhist Affairs shall consult the advisory board and the manner in which such board shall conduct its meetings; and

pool.heading: Power to make regulations
pool.text: prescribing the method of preparing a register of voters for the election of the Diyawadana Nilame and Basnayake Nilames.

pool.heading: Power to make regulations
pool.text: All regulations made under this Ordinance shall be laid as soon as conveniently may be, on the table of Parliament at two successive meetings of Parliament and shall be brought before Parliament at the next subsequent meeting held thereafter by a motion that the said regulations shall not be disapproved; and if upon the introduction of any such motion, or upon any adjournment thereof, the said regulations are disapproved by Parliament, such regulations shall be deemed to be rescinded as from the date of such disapproval but without prejudice to anything already done thereunder and such regulations, if not so disapproved, shall continue to be of full force and effect. Every such disapproval shall be published in the Gazette.

pool.heading: Power to make regulations
pool.text: The breach of any regulation made in pursuance of this section shall be an offence, and shall be punishable on summary conviction by a fine not exceeding one hundred rupees, and in the case of a continuing offence by a further fine not exceeding five rupees for each subsequent day on which such offence continues.

pool.heading: Continuing education.
pool.text: The Council may require registered surveyors to attend specified courses to gain specified experience. or to take other appropriate action. within a specified period for the purpose of maintaining and improving their knowledge and skills in the practice of land surveying.

pool.heading: Continuing education.
pool.text: Where the Council is satisfied that-

pool.heading: Continuing education.
pool.text: a registered surveyor who has been issued with an Annual Practicing Licence has not complied with any of the requirements imposed under subsection (1), the Council may (i) suspend the Annual Practicing Licence of such registered surveyor until the requirements are complied with:

pool.heading: Continuing education.
pool.text: renew the Annual Practicing Licence of such registered surveyor subject to specified conditions, which may include a condition specifying the standard period for which that Annual Practicing license is renewed;

pool.heading: Continuing education.
pool.text: refuse to renew the Annual Practicing Licence of such registered surveyor until those requirements are complied with; or

pool.heading: Continuing education.
pool.text: a registered surveyor who is in the service of the Government has not complied with the requirements imposed under subsection (I) the Council may report such non compliance to the Surveyor-General for appropriate action.

pool.heading: Use of company information.
pool.text: A director of a company who has information in his capacity as a director or employee of the company which would not otherwise be available to him, shall not disclose that information to any person or make use of or act on the information, except-

hierarchy.label: TRANSACTIONS IN WHICH A DIRECTOR IS INTERESTED

pool.text: in accordance with subsection (2); or

hierarchy.label: TRANSACTIONS IN WHICH A DIRECTOR IS INTERESTED

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: Subject to the provisions of this section, where a prospectus invites persons to subscribe for shares in or debentures of a company, the following persons shall be liable to pay compensation to all persons who subscribe for any shares or debentures on the faith of the prospectus, for the loss or damage they may have sustained by reason of any untrue statement included in such prospectus, that is to say:-

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: every person who is a director of the company, at the time of the issue of the prospectus;

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: every person who has authorised himself to be named and is named in the prospectus as a director or as having agreed to become a director, either immediately or after an interval of time;

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: every person being a promoter of the company; and

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: every person who has authorised the issue of the prospectus:

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: Provided that, where under the provisions of section 38, the consent of any person is required to the issue of a prospectus and such person has given such consent, such person shall not by reason of his having given such consent, be liable under the provisions of this subsection as a person who has authorised the issue of the prospectus, except in respect of an untrue statement purporting to be made by him as an expert.

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: No person shall be liable under the provisions of subsection (1), if he proves that-

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: having consented to become a director of the company he withdrew his consent before the issue of the prospectus and that it was issued without his authority or consent;

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: the prospectus was issued without his knowledge or consent and that on becoming aware of its issue, he forthwith gave reasonable public notice that it was issued without his knowledge or consent;

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: after the issue of the prospectus and before allotment thereunder, he on becoming aware of any untrue statement in such prospectus, withdrew his consent thereto and gave reasonable public notice of the withdrawal and of the reasons therefor; or

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: (i) as regards every untrue statement not purporting to be made on the authority of an expert or of a public official document or statement, he had reasonable ground to believe and did up to the time of the allotment of the shares or debentures, as the case may be, believed that the statement was true;

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: as regards every untrue statement purporting to be a statement by an expert or contained in what purports to be a copy of or extract from a report or valuation of an expert, it fairly represented the statement or was a correct and fair copy of or extract from the report or valuation, as the case may be, and he had reasonable ground to believe and did up to the time of the issue of the prospectus believed, that the person making the statement was competent to make it and that person had given the consent required under section 38 to the issue of the prospectus and had not withdrawn that consent before delivery of a copy of the prospectus for registration or to his knowledge, before allotment thereunder; and

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: as regards every untrue statement purporting to be a statement made by a person in his official capacity or contained in what purports to be a copy or extract from a public document issued officially, it was a correct and fair representation of the statement or copy or extract from the document:

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: Provided that the provisions of this subsection shall not apply in the case of a person liable, by reason of his having given the consent required under section 38, as a person who has authorised the issue of the prospectus in respect of an untrue statement purporting to be made by him as an expert.

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: A person who apart from the provisions of this subsection, would under the provisions of subsection (1) be liable by reason of his having given the consent required under the provisions of section 38 as a person who has authorised the issue of a prospectus in respect of an untrue statement purporting to be made by him as an expert, shall not be so liable, if he proves that -

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: having given his consent under the provisions of section 38 to the issue of the prospectus, he withdrew it in writing before delivery of a copy of the prospectus for registration;

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: after delivery of a copy of the prospectus for registration and before allotment thereunder, he on becoming aware of the untrue statement withdrew his consent in writing and gave reasonable public notice of the withdrawal and of the reason therefor; or

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: he was competent to make the statement and that he had reasonable ground to believe and did up to the time of the allotment of the shares or debentures, as the case may be, believed that the statement was true.

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: Where-

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: the prospectus contains the name of a person as a director of the company or as having agreed to become a director of such company and he has not consented to become a director or has withdrawn his consent before the issue of the prospectus and has not authorised or consented to the issue of such prospectus; or

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: the consent of a person is required under section 38 to the issue of the prospectus and he either has not given that consent or has withdrawn it before the issue of the prospectus,

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: the directors of the company, except any director without whose knowledge or consent the prospectus was issued, and any other person who authorised the issue of such prospectus, shall be liable to indemnify the person named under paragraph (a), or whose consent was required under paragraph (b), as the case may be, against all damages, costs and expenses to which he may be made liable by reason of his name having been inserted in the prospectus or of the inclusion therein of a statement purporting to be made by him as an expert, as the case may be, or in defending himself against any action or legal proceeding brought against him in respect thereof:

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: Provided that a person shall not be deemed for the purposes of this subsection to have authorised the issue of a prospectus, by reason only of his having given the consent required under section 38 to the inclusion in such prospectus of a statement purporting to be made by him as an expert.

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: Every person who, by reason of his being a director or being named as a director or as having agreed to become a director or of his having authorised the issue of the prospectus or of the inclusion in such prospectus of a statement purporting to be made by him as an expert, becomes liable to make any payment under this section, may recover contribution as in cases of contract, from any other person who, if sued separately, would have been liable to make the same payment, unless the person who has become so liable was and that other person was not, guilty of fraudulent misrepresentation.

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: For the purposes of this section-

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: "promoter" means a promoter who was a party to the preparation of the prospectus or of the portion thereof containing the untrue statement, but does not include any person by reason of his acting in a professional capacity for persons engaged in procuring the formation of the company; and

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: "expert" has the same meaning as in section 38.

pool.heading: Annual practicing licence.
pool.text: Every registered surveyor who is desirous of practicing or attempting or professing to practise land surveying, shall apply to the Council for an Annual Practicing licence;

pool.heading: Annual practicing licence.
pool.text: Provided however, registered Surveyors in the Survey Department engaging in land surveying under the supervision of the Surveyor General. shall not be required to obtain an Annual Practicing licence for the purpose of engaging in land surveying on behalf of the Government.

pool.heading: Annual practicing licence.
pool.text: The Council may on application received in that behalf by a registered surveyor accompanied by the prescribed fee. issue to such surveyor an Annual Practicing Licence where the Council is satisfied that he has followed the prescribed courses of study and training approved by the Council and acquired knowledge and skill to practise land surveying.

pool.heading: Annual practicing licence.
pool.text: Notwithstanding the provisions of subsection (1), every registered surveyor who is engaged in land surveying on the dale of commencement of this Act may. Continue to practice land surveying for a period of six months from such dale but shall within such period apply for the Annual Practicing Licence under this Act.

pool.heading: Annual practicing licence.
pool.text: Every registered surveyor issued with an Annual Practicing Licence under subsection (2) is referred to in this Act as a "registered licensed surveyor".

Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: A secured creditor may-

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: seize, attach and realise, issue execution against or appoint a receiver in respect of property subject to a charge, if entitled to do so;

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: value the property subject to the charge and claim in the liquidation-

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: as a secured creditor for the amount of his claim, up to the value of the security; and

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: as an unsecured creditor for the balance due, if any; or

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: surrender the charge to the liquidator for the general benefit of creditors, and claim in the liquidation as an unsecured creditor for the whole debt.

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: A secured creditor may exercise the power referred to in paragraph (a) of subsection (1) whether or not the secured creditor has exercised the power referred to in paragraph (b) of subsection (1).

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: A secured creditor who realises property subject to a charge-

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: may claim as an unsecured creditor for any balance due after deducting the net amount realised;

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: shall account to the liquidator for any surplus remaining from the net amount realised after satisfaction of the debt, including interest payable in respect of that debt up to the time of its satisfaction and after making any proper payments to the holder of any other charge over the property subject to the charge.

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: If a secured creditor values the security and claims as a secured creditor, the valuation and claim shall be made in the prescribed form and shall-

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: contain full particulars of the valuation and claim;

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: contain full particulars of the charge including the date on which it was given; and

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: identify any documents that substantiate the claim and the charge,

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: and the provisions of sections 359, 360 and 362 shall apply to any claim as a secured creditor.

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: The liquidator may-

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: require production of any document referred to in paragraph (c) of subsection (4); and

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: require a claim under subsection (4) to be verified by affidavit.

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: Where a claim is made by a secured creditor under subsection (4), the liquidator shall either-

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: accept the valuation and claim; or

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: reject the valuation and claim in whole or in part, but-

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: where a valuation and claim is rejected in whole or in part, the creditor may make a revised valuation and claim within ten working days of receiving notice of the rejection; and

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: the liquidator may if he subsequently considers that a valuation and claim was wrongly rejected in whole or in part, revoke or amend that decision.

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: Where the liquidator-

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: accepts a valuation and claim under paragraph (a) of subsection (6);

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: accepts a revised valuation and claim under subparagraph (i) of paragraph (b) of subsection (6); or

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: accepts a valuation and claim on revoking or amending a decision to reject a claim under subparagraph (ii) of paragraph (b) of subsection (6),

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: the liquidator shall unless the secured creditor has realised the property, redeem the security on payment of the amount of the claim or the assessed value, whichever is the less.

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: The liquidator may at any time by notice in writing, require a secured creditor within twenty working days after receipt of the notice-

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: to elect which of the powers referred to in subsection (1) the creditor whishes to exercise; and

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: if the creditor elects to exercise the power referred to in paragraph (b) or paragraph (c) of that subsection, to exercise the power within that period.

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: A secured creditor on whom notice has been served under subsection (8) and who fails to comply with the notice shall be taken to have surrendered the charge to the liquidator under paragraph (c) of subsection (1) for the general benefit of creditors, and may claim in the liquidation as an unsecured creditor for the whole debt.

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: A secured creditor who has surrendered a charge under paragraph (c) of subsection (1) or who is deemed to have surrendered a charge under subsection (9) may, with the leave of the court or the liquidator and subject to such terms and conditions as the court or the liquidator thinks fit, at any time before the liquidator has realised the property charged-

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: withdraw the surrender and rely on the charge; or

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: submit a new claim under this section.

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: Every person who-

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: makes or authourises the making of a claim under subsection (4) that is false or misleading in a material particular knowing it to be false or misleading; or

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: omits or authorises the omission from a claim under subsection (4) of any matter knowing that the omission makes the claim false or misleading in a material particular,

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding one million rupees or to a term of imprisonment not exceeding five years or to both such fine and imprisonment.

pool.heading: Offences.
pool.text: fails to furnish any return or information as required under this part;

pool.heading: Offences.
pool.text: Knowing makes any false statement in any such return or information furnished by him;

pool.heading: Offences.
pool.text: for the purpose of obtaining registration as a registered surveyor or for the purpose of obtaining an Annual Practicing Licence-

pool.heading: Offences.
pool.text: either orally or in writing makes a declaration or representation that to his knowledge is false or misleading in any material particular; or

pool.heading: Offences.
pool.text: produces to the Council, or makes use of any document knowing it to contain any such false declaration or representation.

pool.heading: Offences.
pool.text: not being a registered surveyor-

pool.heading: Offences.
pool.text: falsely pretends that he is a registered surveyor;

pool.heading: Offences.
pool.text: takes or uses the name or title of a registered surveyor;

pool.heading: Offences.
pool.text: not being a registered licensed surveyor-

pool.heading: Offences.
pool.text: practices land surveying for fee or reward;

pool.heading: Offences.
pool.text: takes or uses any title or description implying that he is a registered licensed surveyor;

pool.heading: Offences.
pool.text: certifies the performance of a land survey;

pool.heading: Offences.
pool.text: certifies or signs any survey plan, iagram, map or other document which is required by this Act or any other written law to be certified by a registered licensed surveyor; or

pool.heading: Offences.
pool.text: being a member, officer or servant of the council discloses any information obtained by him in or in connection with the exercise of his powers or the discharge of his functions under this part to any person for any purpose other than a purpose for which he is authorised to disclose such information by this part;

pool.heading: Offences.
pool.text: contravenes any provision of this Act or any regulation made thereunder,

pool.heading: Offences.
pool.text: shall be guilty of an offence under this Act.

pool.heading: Offences.
pool.text: Every person who commits an offence under this Act for which no punishment of this Act. shall on conviction after summary trial before a magistrate be liable to a fine not exceeding ten thousand rupees or to imprisonment for a period not exceeding three months or to both such fine and imprisonment.

pool.heading: Offences.
pool.text: where an offence under this Act is committed by a body of persons, then-

pool.heading: Offences.
pool.text: if that body of persons is a body corporate every director or officer of that body corporate;

pool.heading: Offences.
pool.text: if that body of persons is a firm, every partner of that firm,

pool.heading: Offences.
pool.text: shall be deemed to be guilty of that offence;

pool.heading: Offences.
pool.text: provided however that a director or an officer of such body corporate or partner of such firm shall not be deemed to be guilty of such offence if he proves that such offence was committed without his knowledge or that he used all due diligence to prevent the commission of such offence.

pool.heading: Offences.
pool.text: Every person who-

pool.heading: Duty to notify breaches of any provisions of this Act.
pool.text: A receiver of a company who considers that the company or any director or officer of the company has committed an offence under this Act or the Securities and Exchange Commission of Sri Lanka Act, No. 36 of 1987, shall report that fact to the Registrar.

pool.heading: Duty to notify breaches of any provisions of this Act.
pool.text: Nothing in subsection (1) shall impose any duty on a receiver to investigate whether any offence of the kind referred to in that subsection has been committed.

pool.heading: Duty to notify breaches of any provisions of this Act.
pool.text: A receiver who fails to comply with the provisions of subsection (1) shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding fifty thousand rupees.

pool.heading: Restrictions on mortgaging lands of which title has passed or has been leased to a foreign national.
pool.text: Any land transferred or leased to a person or a company referred to in section 2(1) or 5(1), after the date on which the certificate of the speaker is endorsed in respect of this Act, shall not for any purpose be been mortgaged or pledged to any bank licensed under the Banking Act, for leased to a foreign a period of five years with effect from the execution of the relevant instrument of transfer or lease.

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Restrictions on mortgaging lands of which title has passed or has been leased to a foreign national.
pool.text: Any mortgage or pledge executed in contravention of subsection (1), shall be void.

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Conditions for the registration of instruments relating to the transfer of title of lands
pool.text: The Registrar of Lands shall not register an instrument effecting any transfer of title referred to in section 2, under the provisions of the Registration of Documents Ordinance, unless such registrar of lands is satisfied that such transfer is in compliance with the provisions of this Act.

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Conditions for the registration of instruments relating to the transfer of title of lands
pool.text: Notwithstanding the provisions of subsection (1), an instrument effecting, the transfer of title of a land to a next of kin (who is a foreigner) of an owner of such land, shall be registered by the Registrar of Lands, where the notary public attesting such instrument of transfer certifies in his attestation that the transferee is the next of kin of the owner of the land transferred, as recognized by the applicable laws of succession of Sri Lanka.

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Conditions for the registration of instruments relating to the transfer of title of lands
pool.text: Where any question arises whether a person is the next of kin of the owner of the land or which law is applicable to the succession, the Registrar of Lands shall refer the matter to the District Court having jurisdiction over the area in which the relevant land is situated, for a determination through summary proceeding.

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Conditions for the registration of instruments relating to the transfer of title of lands
pool.text: Where the title of a land is transferred to a company incorporated in Sri Lanka under the Companies Act, with less than fifty per cent of foreign shareholding, it shall be the duty of the Registrar of Lands to confirm himself whether the foreign shareholding of such company is less than fifty per cent, by requiring the secretary of such company to submit documentary proof to the effect that the foreign shareholding of such company is less than fifty per cent of the total number of shares issued for the time being.

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Conditions for the registration of instruments relating to the transfer of title of lands
pool.text: The secretary to the relevant company shall inform the Registrar of Lands in writing in every six months period commencing from the date of the registration of the relevant deed of transfer, that the foreign shareholding of such company has not exceeded fifty per cent of the total number of shares issued by such company, during the said period of six months.

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Conditions for the registration of instruments relating to the transfer of title of lands
pool.text: Where the foreign shareholding of a company referred to in paragraph (a) reaches or exceeds fifty per cent the relevant Registrar of Land shall make a note to that effect in the relevant folio.

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Conditions for the registration of instruments relating to the transfer of title of lands
pool.text: For the purposes of this section 'Registrar of Lands' means the respective Registrar of Lands of the land registry, to whom the instrument of transfer is presented for registration.

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: In this Act unless the context otherwise requires-

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "alienation"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means transfer, lease or mortgage of lands situated within Sri Lanka;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Apartment Ownership Law"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means the Apartment Ownership Law, No. 11 of 1973;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Banking Act"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means the Banking Act, No. 30 of 1988;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Citizenship Act"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means Citizenship Act (Chapter 349);

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "citizen of Sri Lanka"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means a citizen of Sri Lanka in terms of Citizenship Act;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Companies Act"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means the Companies Act, No. 7 of 2007;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Commissioner General of Inland Revenue"
pool.provision_label: 25, definition of "Commissioner General of Inland Revenue"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means the Commissioner General of Inland Revenue appointed or deemed to be appointed under the Inland Revenue Act;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014
Definition of "Commissioner General of Inland Revenue"

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Diplomatic Privileges Act"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means the Diplomatic Privileges Act, No. 9 of 1996;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "foreigner"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means a person who is not a citizen of Sri Lanka;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "foreign company"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means a company or a body of persons incorporated under the laws of any country other than Sri Lanka;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Finance Leasing Act"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means the Finance Leasing Act, No. 56 of 2000;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Finance Leasing Institution"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means a Finance Leasing Establishment registered under the Finance Leasing Act;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "holding company"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: has the same meaning assigned to such expression under the Companies Act;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Inland Revenue Act"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means the Inland Revenue Act, No. 10 of 2006;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "land"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means any State or private land and includes-

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "land"(a)
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: any interest in the land;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "land"(b)
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: any land covered with water; and

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "land"(c)
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: any house or building stands on that land;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Minister"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means the Minister to whom the subject of Finance has been assigned;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "transfer"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means any sale, donation, gift or any conveyance by or under which the title of such land passes to another person;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "person"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: includes a body of persons incorporate or unincorporated;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Registration of Documents Ordinance"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means the Registration of Documents Ordinance (Chapter 117);

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "subsidiary"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: has the same meaning assigned to such expression under the Companies Act.

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: The provisions of section 2 shall not apply to-

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: any land the title of which is transferred to a Diplomatic Mission of another State within the meaning of the Diplomatic Privileges Act or to an International, Multilateral or Bilateral Organization recognized in terms of that Act;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: a condominium parcel specified under the Apartment Ownership Law:

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 3(1)(b), proviso
pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: Provided that, the entire value shall be paid upfront through an inward foreign remittance prior to the execution of the relevant deed of transfer;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: any land the title of which is transferred to a foreign investor in consequence to a decision of the Cabinet of Ministers taken prior to January 1, 2013, involving direct investment of foreign currency, as per the related agreements on such investment structured on the basis of any written law governing the tax regime prior to January 1, 2013, and has ensured compliance by making inward remittances to Sri Lanka;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: any land the title of which is transferred by intestacy, gift or testamentary disposition to a next of kin (who is a foreigner) of the in accordance with the applicable law of succession of Sri Lanka;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: any land the title of which is transferred to a dual citizen of Sri Lanka within the meaning of the Citizenship Act;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: any land the title of which is transferred to any bank licensed under the Banking Act, in which any foreign shareholding is fifty per cent or above-

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: at an auction conducted by such Bank in terms of the Recovery of Loans by Banks (Special Provisions) Act, No. 4 of 1990 or Mortgage Act (Chapter 89), in the discharge of a mortgage of such land to such Bank;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: in execution of a decree of court to enforce the recovery of a loan given by such bank;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: any land the title of which is transferred to any Finance Leasing Institution in which any foreign shareholding is fifty per cent or above-

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: where such land has been mortgaged to such Finance Leasing Institution as a security for a lease;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: in order to execute a lease and an agreement to sell or a loan and an agreement to sell;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: in execution of a decree of court to enforce the recovery of a loan given by such Institution;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: any land, the title of which was transferred to a company referred to in section 2(1)(b), during the period commencing from January 1, 2013 and ending on the date on which the certificate of the speaker is endorsed in respect of this Act, provided such company has been in active operation in Sri Lanka for a period of not less than ten (10) consecutive years prior to the date of transfer of such land; and

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: any land, the title of which is transferred on or after April 1, 2018, to a company referred to in paragraph (b) of subsection (1) of section 2, listed in the Colombo Stock Exchange.

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: The Minister may in consultation with the Minister to whom the subject of lands has been assigned and with the prior written approval of the Cabinet of Ministers, by Order published in the Gazette, exempt any foreign entity engaged in the banking, financial, insurance, maritime, aviation, advanced technology or infrastructure development project identified as a Strategic Development Project, in terms of the provisions of the Strategic Development Projects Act, No. 14 of 2008, from the application of the provisions of section 2.

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: The Minister may in consultation with the Minister to whom the subject of Lands has been assigned and with the prior written approval of the Cabinet of Ministers, by Order published in the Gazette, exempt any foreign company engaged in international commercial operations, from the application of the provisions of section 2, where the land is purchased to locate or relocate its global or regional operations or to set up a branch office.

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: Where the transfer of title of a land is effected in terms of this section, the provisions of this Act shall also apply to every subsequent transfer of title of such land or part thereof.

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Restrictions on the leasing of lands to foreigners
pool.text: Notwithstanding any provision to the contrary in any other written law, the leasing of a land-

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Restrictions on the leasing of lands to foreigners
pool.text: to a foreigner; or

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Restrictions on the leasing of lands to foreigners
pool.text: to a company incorporated in Sri Lanka under the Companies Act, where any foreign shareholding in such company, either direct or indirect, is fifty per cent or above; or

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Restrictions on the leasing of lands to foreigners
pool.text: to a foreign company, shall be effected subject to the payment of the Land Lease Tax imposed under section 6:

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 5(1)(c), proviso
pool.heading: Restrictions on the leasing of lands to foreigners
pool.text: Provided however, the maximum tenure of any such lease shall not exceed ninety nine years.

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Restrictions on the leasing of lands to foreigners
pool.text: Any State land so leased shall be re-vested on the State free of encumbrances upon the lapse of the period of lease.

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Restrictions on the leasing of lands to foreigners
pool.text: Any state land so leased shall not be sub-let or subleased violating the provisions of relevant indenture of lease or without obtaining the prior written approval from the Minister to whom the subject of lands has been assigned.

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Legal effect of reconstructed folio.
pool.text: A reconstructed folio prepared, authenticated and inserted in a land register in accordance with the provisions of this Ordinance shall for all purposes be deemed to have the same legal force and effect as the lost folio or the mutilated or damaged folio which such reconstructed folio replaces.

hierarchy.label: Land Registers (Reconstructed Folios) Ordinance No. 18 of 1945

pool.heading: Transfer by legal representative.
pool.text: A transfer of the shares or other interests of a deceased shareholder of a company made by his legal representative shall, although the legal representative is not himself a shareholder of the company, be as valid as if he had been such a shareholder at the time of the execution of the instrument of transfer.

hierarchy.label: TRANSFER OF SHARES AND DEBENTURES, EVIDENCE OF TITLE &C .

pool.heading: Short title and date of operation
pool.text: This Act may be cited as the Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, No. 38 of 2014.

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Short title and date of operation
pool.text: The provisions of this Act shall be deemed to have come into operation with effect from January 1, 2013.

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Exemption from the Land Lease Tax
pool.text: The Land Lease Tax payable under section 6, shall not be applicable on the lease of-

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Exemption from the Land Lease Tax
pool.text: any land a Diplomatic Mission of another State within the meaning of the Diplomatic Privileges Act or to an International, Multilateral or Bilateral Organization recognized in terms of that Act;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Exemption from the Land Lease Tax
pool.text: a condominium parcel situated on or above the fourth floor of a building specified under the provisions of the Apartment Ownership Law (excluding the ground level floor and floors which accommodate any common element or elements within the meaning of Apartment Ownership Law) where the period of lease is thirty five years or above and the lease rental for the full period of lease is paid through inward remittance of foreign currency on or prior to the date of the execution of the relevant indenture of lease;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Exemption from the Land Lease Tax
pool.text: any land to a dual citizen of Sri Lanka within the meaning of the Citizenship Act;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Exemption from the Land Lease Tax
pool.text: any land to a foreign investor in consequent to a decision of the Cabinet of Ministers taken prior to January 1, 2013, involving direct investment of foreign currency as per the related agreements on such investment, and structured on the basis of any written law governing the tax regime prior to January 1, 2013, and has ensured compliance by making inward foreign remittances to Sri Lanka;

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Exemption from the Land Lease Tax
pool.text: any land situated within a Bonded Area or a Free Port declared under the Finance Act, No. 12 of 2012.

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Exemption from the Land Lease Tax

hierarchy.label: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014

pool.heading: Exemption from the Land Lease Tax
pool.text: The Minister may in consultation with the Minister to whom the subject of Lands has been assigned and with the prior written approval of the Cabinet of Ministers, by Order published in the Gazette, exempt any foreign company engaged in international commercial operations, from the application of the provisions of section 6, where the land is leased to locate or relocate its global or regional operations or to set up a branch office.
